items.title: 伸興、程泰集團達成董事提名共識 程泰獲1席
items.title_en: Shin Sheng and Cheng Tai Group Reach Consensus on Board Nomination; Cheng Tai Secures One Seat
paras: 全球縫紉機製造大廠伸興(1558-TW)因應今年度全體董事改選，於27日正式公告新任董事(含獨立董事)候選人名單，經與程泰集團理性協商，雙方已就本次股東臨時會董事提名安排達成共識。雙方同意以公司長期發展及全體股東權益為共同目標，透過良性溝通與合作，為公司未來經營與公司治理建立穩健基礎。
依雙方達成之共識，本次董事提名安排為，伸興提名三名一般董事候選人，分別為林志誠、蔡崇廷、廖樹城；提名三名獨立董事候選人，分別為黃惠玉、許永聲、施芸婷；程泰提名一名一般董事候選人，為弘華投資股份有限公司代表人王丞軒。
雙方將依相關法令及公司章程規定，辦理後續董事選舉及相關程序。
伸興表示，公司始終秉持誠信經營、穩健發展及股東權益優先的理念，持續致力於提升經營績效、強化公司治理及創造長期企業價值。此次雙方透過理性溝通與協商取得共識，展現各方對公司長期發展的重視，也有助於凝聚股東力量，為公司未來經營與治理奠定穩健基礎。
伸興表示，程泰集團為台灣工具機龍頭品牌，具備行銷全球的亮眼實績，而伸興集團亦是全球縫紉機的領導廠商。程泰集團加入伸興董事會後，未來無論是在公司治理、精實生產、行銷策略方面雙方都可深化合作，交流互惠，在經營績效方面共創雙贏。
伸興表示，公司長期深化ESG與維護股東權益，且與所有支持伸興的重要股東保持暢通溝通，這也是伸興在公司治理評鑒晉升「6%至20%」前段班行列的關鍵原因。本次董事候選人名單是基於公司未來全球布局與智慧自動化轉型的戰略需求，在既有的強大製造與研發基礎上，廣納各方專業意見後所提出的最佳陣容，以全體股東最大利益為依歸。
而在獨立董事專業上，伸興仍提名具備財務會計、法律合規及產業管理等多元專業背景，落實公司治理，且完全符合主管機關對上市櫃公司董事會多元化與獨立性之高標準要求。未來新任董事會成立後，將能以更客觀、前瞻的視角審視公司重大資本支出、全球產能布局及永續經營（ESG）策略，進一步提升公司治理透明度。
伸興指出，面對全球供應鏈重組與智慧製造浪潮，企業需要無可取代的全球交付能力與核心技術，以及更具備戰略高度與跨界資源的治理團隊。本次董事候選人名單的提出，展現伸興以行業領導者之姿，積極整合內外部優勢資源、持續擴大競爭護城河的決心。伸興未來將繼續深化核心技術研發，並提升全球營運效率，以亮眼的營運實績，回饋所有股東與合作夥伴。
paras_en: Shin Sheng (1558-TW), a global leader in sewing machine manufacturing, announced on the 27th the list of new board (including independent directors) candidates in response to this year’s full board election. After rational negotiations with Cheng Tai Group, both parties have reached a consensus on the board nominations for the upcoming shareholders’ special meeting. They agree to pursue the company’s long‑term development and the interests of all shareholders as a common goal, using constructive communication and cooperation to lay a solid foundation for future operations and corporate governance.

According to the agreement, Shin Sheng will nominate three ordinary director candidates—Lin Chih‑cheng, Tsai Chong‑ting, and Liao Shu‑cheng—and three independent director candidates—Huang Hui‑yu, Hsu Yung‑sheng, and Shih Yun‑ting. Cheng Tai will nominate one ordinary director candidate, Wang Cheng‑hsuan, representing Honghua Investment Co., Ltd.
Both sides will follow applicable laws and the company’s articles of incorporation to carry out the subsequent director election and related procedures.

Shin Sheng stated that the company consistently upholds the principles of integrity, steady growth, and prioritizing shareholder rights, continuously striving to improve performance, strengthen governance, and create long‑term corporate value. The consensus reached through rational dialogue demonstrates each party’s commitment to the company’s long‑term development and helps unite shareholder support, establishing a robust foundation for future management and governance.

Shin Sheng noted that Cheng Tai Group is Taiwan’s leading brand in machine tools with impressive global marketing achievements, while Shin Sheng is a worldwide leader in sewing machines. With Cheng Tai joining the board, both parties can deepen cooperation in governance, lean production, and marketing strategies, fostering mutual benefit and a win‑win in operational performance.

Shin Sheng emphasized its ongoing commitment to ESG and protecting shareholder interests, maintaining open communication with all key shareholders—a key factor in its advancement to the top tier of corporate‑governance ratings (from 6% to 20%). The board candidate list reflects the strategic needs of global expansion and smart‑automation transformation, drawing on a strong manufacturing and R&D base and diverse professional input to serve the greatest benefit of all shareholders.

Regarding independent directors, Shin Sheng continues to nominate individuals with diverse expertise in finance, accounting, legal compliance, and industry management, meeting the high standards for board diversity and independence set by regulators. Once the new board is formed, it will review major capital expenditures, global capacity planning, and ESG strategies with greater objectivity and foresight, further enhancing governance transparency.

Shin Sheng pointed out that amid global supply‑chain restructuring and the wave of smart manufacturing, companies need irreplaceable global delivery capabilities, core technologies, and a governance team with strategic depth and cross‑industry resources. The proposed board slate demonstrates Shin Sheng’s resolve, as an industry leader, to integrate internal and external strengths, expand its competitive moat, deepen core technology R&D, and improve global operational efficiency, delivering strong performance to shareholders and partners.

items.title: 英國啟動冷戰後最大戰時動員準備！10萬預備役收通知、歐洲多國加速備戰
paras: 英國國防部正加強戰時動員準備，已向約10萬名戰略預備役人員寄發信函，要求更新聯絡方式、居住地址及退役後的民間專業技能資訊。這是英國自冷戰結束以來，規模最大的戰時動員準備行動之一，反映英國面對歐洲安全局勢升溫，正重新檢視國防人力與軍事應變能力。
不過，英國國防大臣Wes Streeting與退伍軍人事務大臣Calvin Bailey在26日相關消息曝光後，先後出面說明指出，此次發函屬於例行行政整頓及預防性措施，並不代表即將啟動戰時動員。
英國國防部同時計劃邀請最多約1000名戰略預備役人員自願參與軍事演習，其中包括2027年春季舉行的北約「堅定捍衛者」（Steadfast Defender）演習。

英國重啟冷戰後預備役動員機制

根據媒體報導，英國國防部目前缺乏約一半戰略預備役人員的最新有效地址，因此此次信函由陸、海、空三軍參謀長共同簽署，要求相關人員確認居住地址、聯絡方式，以及退役後累積的民間工作經驗與專業技能。
英國軍方認為，退伍軍人在網路安全、醫療、後勤、電信及能源等領域累積的專業能力，未來在軍事衝突中可能具有重要價值。
戰略預備役的動員順位，則排在全職現役軍人及正規預備役部隊之後，後兩者將在衝突初期優先投入作戰。
冷戰期間，英國曾為戰略預備役人員配發制服與裝備，並安排年度訓練。不過，隨著蘇聯解體，相關制度受到國防預算及戰略環境變化影響，逐漸停止運作。此次重新確認預備役人員資料，被視為英國冷戰結束後再次實質推動相關動員機制。
根據《路透》、英國廣播公司等媒體報導，Streeting此前曾警告，英國必須為未來1000天內可能爆發的戰爭做好準備，並將俄羅斯列為主要安全威脅。他也呼籲民眾提高警覺，配合政府宣導，讓家庭預先儲備足以維持三天生活的必需品。
在制度方面，英國國會正推動《武裝部隊法案》，計劃將非軍官退役人員的召回年齡上限，從55歲提高至65歲，並允許政府在進入「備戰階段」時啟動召回機制。

核潛艇維護合約擴大 國防支出持續增加

在人力動員之外，英國也透過長期合約及預算規劃，強化軍事嚇阻能力。
11月26日，Streeting與英國國防承包商Babcock簽署一份為期五年、總額80億英鎊的合約，另附帶一項7億英鎊協議，負責維護英國核潛艇艦隊。這項合約預計支撐約8500個工作機會。
英國皇家空軍近期也在夜間將戰鬥機轉移至加固機堡，並準備反無人機網，以因應無人機帶來的安全風險。
自2022年以來，英國對烏克蘭的援助承諾總額已達355億英鎊。英國上周另宣布一項總額2.6億英鎊的軍事援助計畫，其中包括提供1000架英國製造的遠程無人機。
根據英國預算規劃，國防支出將在2027至2028財年提高至國內生產毛額（GDP）的2.7%，目標是在2030年達到3%。英國也支持北約提出的目標，即在2035年前將軍事及相關安全支出提高至GDP的5%。
持續增加的國防預算與長期軍事合約，有助於提高國防承包商及工業製造業的訂單能見度，但也意味著政府未來必須承擔更龐大的長期財政支出。

歐洲多國加速備戰 俄羅斯否認攻擊北約計畫

英國重新檢視預備役制度，也與歐洲各國近年加快軍事整備的趨勢相呼應。
法國於2025年11月推出針對18至19歲青年的10個月有薪志願兵役計畫，並於2026年啟動首批3000個名額，目標是在2030年增加至1萬人、2035年達到5萬人。此外，法國也計劃將作戰預備役人數從目前約4.7萬人，擴大至8萬至10萬人。
德國則自2026年1月1日起實施《兵役現代化法》，維持志願入伍制度，但要求18歲男性進行登記、填寫問卷並接受體檢。
波蘭推動自願軍事訓練，計劃從2027年起每年培訓10萬名公民。北歐及東歐國家的軍事整備步伐也持續加快，芬蘭自2026年1月1日起將預備役年齡上限提高至65歲，朝2031年預備役人數達到約100萬人的目標邁進。
克羅埃西亞於2026年3月恢復為期兩個月的強制兵役，丹麥則將男女平等適用的服役期限從4個月延長至11個月。西班牙維持職業化軍隊制度，但也擴大志願預備役名額。
對於歐洲國家接連強化軍事部署，俄羅斯多次否認有意攻擊北約成員國，並將相關說法斥為「無稽之談」，指責西方政府刻意渲染外部威脅，以轉移國內問題的注意力。
俄羅斯總統普丁上周也表示，俄羅斯無意攻擊任何國家，並批評歐洲領導人反覆宣稱必須在2030年前做好戰爭準備。

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉AI重點筆記2026/11/27
items.title_en: First Financial Holding Investor Presentation – AI Highlights (2026/11/27)
paras: 一、營運亮點
金控獲利創同期新高：2026 年前三季金控稅後淨利達 262.25 億元，年增 26.9%，EPS 為 1.82 元。旗艦子公司第一銀行獲利達 232 億元（年增 13%）續創新高；非銀行子公司獲利合計達 40 億元超越往年新高，占金控獲利比重由以往不到 9% 提高至 14% 以上，獲利結構更趨多元穩健。
銀行核心業務雙位數成長：受惠放款穩健擴張，一銀淨利息收入年增 14.6%；資本市場熱絡帶動財富管理手續費收入大增 30.8%，推升整體淨手收年增 23.3%。
企業融資需求熱絡：在 AI 相關產業投資與營運資金需求帶動下，一銀總放款年增 12.9%。其中外幣放款及大企業放款均呈雙位數年成長；中小企業放款突破 1 兆元（年增 8%）穩居市場領先；房貸亦穩健成長 5.8%。
推動公股投信整併：金控董事會已於 10 月 22 日通過推動公股投信整併案，未來將由第一金投信擔任存續公司，打造國家級資產管理平台，整合各方通路、產品及投研資源以深化營運規模與市場競爭優勢。
二、金控財務概要與各子公司表現
金控財務指標全面提升：2026 年前三季總資產穩健成長 9.5%，每股淨值提升 9.4% 至 21.5 元。平均淨值報酬率（ROE）由去年同期的 10.01% 大幅提升至 11.61%，平均資產報酬率（ROA）由 0.57% 升至 0.67%。集團資本適足率維持 124.16% 高水準，雙重槓桿比率穩健控制在 114.5%。
合併損益爆發力強勁：前三季合併淨收益年增 16.9% 至 626 億元；在信用成本與營業費用控管得宜下，稅後淨利年增 26.9% 至 262 億元，加上其他綜合損益挹注，合併綜合損益達 389 億元。
各子公司稅後淨利表現：
第一金證券：稅後淨利提升至 20 億元，年增率高達 165.2%。
第一金人壽：受惠投資收益亮眼及接軌 IFRS 17 後體質良好，稅後淨利由去年同期的 0.76 億元躍升至 6.48 億元。
第一金投信：獲利年增 120.5% 達 2.91 億元。
第一金 AMC 及第一金創投：亦分別繳出強勁的獲利成長表現。
年化 ROE 表現優於過往：金控前三季累積淨利已接近 2025 年全年水準，今年以來年化 ROE 維持在 11% 以上（優於過去兩年 9.6% 至 10.8% 區間）；一銀第三季年化 ROE 達 9.79%，亦優於去年同期的 9.55% 及全年的 8.79%。
三、第一銀行業務表現
稅前獲利結構：前三季累積淨收益達 545.7 億元，年增 9.0%。儘管金融商品收益微減，但兩大核心淨利收（年增 14.6% 達 261 億元）與淨手收（年增 23.3% 達 119 億元）完全彌補缺口；呆帳費用及相關手收費用與去年同期相當，營業費用則隨業務成長適度增加 7%。
放款規模跨越 3 兆元：截至 9 月底總放款餘額由去年同期的 2.7 兆元跨越至 3.09 兆元，年增 12.9%。其中外幣放款年增 22.5%、大企業放款年增 17.2%、中小企業放款年增 8% 達 1 兆 721 億元（蟬聯市場領導地位）。第三季單季放款大增 1,472 億元（季增 5%），全業務皆呈季正成長。

存放比與存放利差（NIM）：整體存放比由去年同期的 70.34% 升至第三季的 74.46%（台幣 88.6%、外幣 46.4%）；前三季存放利差為 1.18%，NIM 為 0.75%。第三季台幣放款利率增 1 點至 2.37%、存款利率 1.08%，台幣利差升 1 點至 1.29%；外幣放款與存款利率分別季增 10 點與 11 點，外幣利差增 1 點至 1.96%，惟受外幣存放比 46.4% 及貨幣市場資金略緊影響，第三季整體 NIM 較第二季減少 1 點。
存款規模突破 4 兆元與高活存比：第三季總存款年增 6.5% 突破 4 兆元大關，其中新台幣存款年增 3.7% 至 2.87 兆元，外幣存款大增 13.6% 達 1.2 兆元。憑藉企業金流與薪轉戶基礎，第三季台幣活存比穩步上升至 62.14%。
產業集中度分散：放款結構中製造業占 22.95%（電子資訊業達 5.66%），非製造業占 77.05%，產業分布多元分散。
房貸業務與風險控管：第三季新承作房貸金額為 320.7 億元，平均成數 64.94%；整體房貸餘額平均貸放成數低至 49%，平均房貸利率維持 2.32%。區域分布以北北基及桃園合計占比高達 63.1%，擔保品流動性與保值性優異。
手續費收入與營業費用率：前三季財管手收由去年同期 65.28 億元大增 30.8% 至 85.4 億元，占整體淨手收比重由 67.4% 突破七成至 71.5%；放款相關手收亦年增 6.6%。單看第三季淨手收為 39.45 億元，因第二季基期較高及金融市場波動加劇而季減 6.5%。前三季累積營業費用占比由去年同期的 43.01% 下降 0.75 個百分點至 42.26%。

資產品質與資本適足率：截至 9 月底整體逾放比穩守 0.16%，呆帳覆蓋率達 864.09%；其中大型企業維持零逾放、中小企業 0.19%、房貸 0.07%、個人放款 0.09%。海外業務前三季稅前獲利達 76.20 億元，占全行稅前獲利 27.46%，單季連三季成長創近期新高。第三季銀行資本適足率為 14.8%，第一類資本比率 12.69%，CET1 為 11.27%，均高於系統性重要銀行法定標準。
四、Q&A 問答重點整理
2027 年全球與台灣經濟景氣展望
Q：2026 年 GDP 整體成長相當不錯，現已接近年底，經營團隊對 2027 年全球及台灣的景氣看法為何？（綜合提問）

A： 全球經濟：2026 年雖受中東戰爭與能源價格上升干擾，但受惠 AI 高效能運算與雲端服務投資擴張，全球 GDP 預估成長 3.1%。2027 年能源衝擊將逐步消化，AI 資本支出續撐復甦，全球 GDP 預估值維持 3.4% 不變。 台灣前景：受惠 AI 及半導體供應鏈需求強勁帶動出口與民間投資，2026 年台灣 GDP 有望突破 12%。2027 年在極高基期墊高下增幅自然趨緩，但仍延續正增長趨勢，公司內部預估（In-house view）2027 年台灣經濟成長率約落在 6% 左右。
2027 年放款業務成長預估
Q：2026 年第三季簡報顯示放款仍有高達 13% 左右的年成長，符合今年雙位數成長的 guidance，請問對 2027 年放款業務的看法與預估？（統一投顧 Tina）
A： 預估 2027 年一銀總放款成長率約為 5% 到 6%。 策略將以「擇優擴量、資本增效」為核心調整結構，明年重點著重在中小企業放款，預估成長率可達 10%；房屋貸款預估成長約 4.5%；外幣放款預估成長約 9%，將持續聚焦 AI 半導體重點業務、高收益海外放款案及台商赴美投資商機。
淨利差（NIM）與 FX Swap 收益展望
Q1：今年淨利差表現呈現稍微下滑現象，如何看待明年調整後淨利差（含 Swap）的水準？明年的 Swap 收益看法為何？（凱基證券 Eric、統一投顧 Tina）
Q2：明年 Swap 收益預估成長，但調整後 NIM 較今年預估略往下，是否代表原始 NIM 下滑及其原因？預估中是否已隱含美台利率政策調整？（統一投顧 Tina）
Q3：再次確認 2026 全年含 Swap 的調整後 NIM 預估值為何？（凱基證券 Eric）

A： 2026 全年預估：今年（預計至 12 月）加計 Swap 之後的調整後 NIM 預估來到 1%；FX Swap 前 10 月收益約 90 億元，2026 全年目標挑戰 105 億元。 2027 全年預估：2027 年含 Swap 的調整後 NIM 預估可達 1.02%；因美元升息帶動台美利差擴大，明年 Swap 收益目標挑戰 125 億至 127 億元（約 126 億元）。 利差變動與利率假設：去年 9 月 Fed 降息使外幣利差收窄，今年 9 月 Fed 重啟升息趨勢加上 AI 帶動資金需求、市場流動性趨緊及 LCR 管制，預期市場資金成本上揚將影響剩餘資金運用收益。預估中已納入利率政策假設，未來將透過提高外幣存放比、優化台外幣存放結構、強化高收益資產配置及靈活操作 Swap，帶動明年整體淨利收與 NIM 表現優於今年。
手續費收入與財富管理業務展望
Q1：簡報顯示第三季財富管理手收季減 6.5%，雖然今年整體手收強勁，但第三季較第二季下滑的原因為何？如何看待第四季與明年？（匿名提問）
Q2：展望 2027 年，對整體手續費收入及財富管理業務的成長動能預估為何？（延續提問）
A： 第三季季減原因與第四季展望：主因全球市場波動，保險與信託手收不如上半年亮麗，第四季預估維持與第三季相當的水準。 推展重點與 2027 目標：下半年與明年將持續聚焦高資產業務與亞洲資產管理中心（亞灣）業務，全力推廣 Lombard Lending（倫巴底貸款）、保費融資及家族辦公室業務。預估 2027 年整體手續費收入維持雙位數成長，其中財富管理手收以成長 15% 為目標。
中小企業資產品質、信用成本與營業費用率展望
Q1：簡報中顯示中小企業的逾放比（NPL）較第二季微幅上升，請問中小企業 NPL 是否有特別疑慮？上升原因為何？（高盛證券 Simon）
Q2：今年前三季信用成本維持不錯，請問今年全年淨信用成本與當初預估值是否調整？明年的淨信用成本預估為何？（延續提問）
Q3：明年的營業費用率（CI Ratio）預估為何？（統一投顧 Tina）

A： 中小企業 NPL：大型企業逾放比維持 0%，中小企業僅由 0.18% 微升至 0.19%（增加 0.01%），主因偶有零星個案產生，金額不大且無系統性風險；整體逾放比仍穩守 0.16%，資產品質相當良好。 淨信用成本：2026 年初預估全年淨信用成本為 18 個 bp，截至 9 月底實際數為 16 個 bp；預估 2027 年淨信用成本維持 18 個 bp。 營業費用率：與往年水準相當，預估 2027 年營業費用率（CI Ratio）約落在 42% 到 43% 左右。
股利配發政策
Q：過往對外溝通配發率約在六成左右，而配發 2025 年度股利時現金配發率高達 69%，請問 2026 年度（明年配發）的股利配發是否有可能達到此水準，或經營團隊的目標為何？（凱基證券 Eric）
A： 公司股利政策以發放現金股利為主，原則上現金股利配發率（Payout Ratio）仍以六成以上為基本目標。 實際配發水準需併同考量子公司股利上繳情形、明年業務發展計畫以及資本管理對業務成長的支援需求，待明年整體狀況衡量後再提案至董事會討論，會盡量回饋股東的長期支持。
paras_en: 1. Operating Highlights

2. The holding company posted record profit for the period: net profit after tax for the first three quarters of 2026 reached NT$26.225 billion, up 26.9% year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$1.82. The flagship subsidiary, First Bank, earned NT$23.2 billion (up 13%) – a new high; non‑bank subsidiaries together earned NT$4.0 billion, surpassing previous peaks and raising their share of total profit from under 9% to above 14%, making the profit structure more diversified and stable.

3. Core banking businesses grew at double‑digit rates: Net interest income rose 14.6% year‑over‑year, driven by steady loan expansion; a hot capital‑markets environment boosted wealth‑management fee income by 30.8%, lifting overall net fee income by 23.3% year‑over‑year.

4. Corporate financing demand remained strong: AI‑related industry investments and working‑capital needs pushed total loan balances up 12.9% year‑over‑year. Both foreign‑currency loans and large‑enterprise loans posted double‑digit growth; SME loans broke the NT$1 trillion mark (up 8%) and stayed market‑leading; mortgage loans also grew solidly at 5.8%.

5. Promotion of public‑sector fund merger: The board approved on Oct 22 a plan to merge public‑sector mutual funds, with First Financial Investment Trust becoming the surviving entity, creating a national‑level asset‑management platform that integrates distribution channels, products and research resources to deepen scale and competitive advantage.
6. 2. Financial Summary of the Holding Company and Subsidiary Performance

7. Financial metrics improved across the board: Total assets grew 9.5% in the first three quarters of 2026, and book value per share rose 9.4% to NT$21.5. Average return on equity (ROE) jumped from 10.01% a year ago to 11.61%, and average return on assets (ROA) increased from 0.57% to 0.67%. The group’s capital adequacy ratio stayed at a high 124.16%, and the dual‑leverage ratio was kept steady at 114.5%.

8. Consolidated earnings showed strong momentum: Consolidated net profit for the first three quarters rose 16.9% year‑over‑year to NT$62.6 billion; with credit costs and operating expenses well‑controlled, net profit after tax grew 26.9% to NT$26.2 billion, and other comprehensive income added up to a consolidated comprehensive profit of NT$38.9 billion.
9. After‑tax net profit of each subsidiary:
10. First Financial Securities: after‑tax net profit rose to NT$2.0 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 165.2%.
11. First Financial Life: benefiting from strong investment returns and a solid post‑IFRS 17 footing, after‑tax net profit jumped from NT$0.076 billion a year ago to NT$6.48 billion.
12. First Financial Investment Trust: profit grew 120.5% to NT$2.91 billion.
13. First Financial AMC and First Financial Venture Capital also delivered strong profit growth.

14. Annualised ROE now exceeds historical levels: the holding company’s cumulative net profit for the first three quarters is close to the full‑year 2025 figure, and the annualised ROE this year has stayed above 11% (higher than the 9.6%‑10.8% range of the past two years); First Bank’s Q3 annualised ROE reached 9.79%, also above the 9.55% a year ago and the full‑year 8.79% level.
15. 3. First Bank Business Performance

16. Pre‑tax profit structure: cumulative net profit for the first three quarters reached NT$54.57 billion, up 9.0% year‑over‑year. Although income from financial products slipped slightly, the two core profit drivers – net interest income (up 14.6% to NT$26.1 billion) and net fee income (up 23.3% to NT$11.9 billion) – fully offset the gap; loan‑loss provisions and related fee expenses were flat versus last year, while operating expenses rose modestly 7% in line with business growth.

17. Loan portfolio surpassed NT$3 trillion: as of end‑September, total loan balance grew from NT$2.7 trillion a year ago to NT$3.09 trillion, a 12.9% increase. Foreign‑currency loans rose 22.5%, large‑enterprise loans 17.2%, and SME loans grew 8% to NT$1.721 trillion, maintaining market‑leadership. Q3 alone saw loan additions of NT$147.2 billion (up 5% quarter‑over‑quarter), with all business lines posting positive quarterly growth.

18. Deposit ratio and net interest margin (NIM): the overall deposit ratio climbed from 70.34% a year ago to 74.46% in Q3 (NT$88.6% for TWD deposits, 46.4% for foreign‑currency deposits); the three‑quarter average NIM was 0.75% with a spread of 1.18%. In Q3, the TWD loan rate rose 1 percentage point to 2.37% while the deposit rate was 1.08%, widening the TWD spread to 1.29% (+1 ppt). Foreign‑currency loan and deposit rates each rose 10‑11 ppt quarter‑over‑quarter, pushing the foreign‑currency spread to 1.96% (+1 ppt). However, because the foreign‑currency deposit ratio stayed at 46.4% and money‑market funding was slightly tight, overall NIM fell by 1 ppt versus Q2.

19. Deposits broke the NT$4 trillion barrier with a high active‑deposit ratio: Q3 total deposits grew 6.5% year‑over‑year, surpassing NT$4 trillion. TWD deposits rose 3.7% to NT$2.87 trillion, while foreign‑currency deposits surged 13.6% to NT$1.2 trillion. Leveraging corporate cash flows and payroll‑transfer accounts, the TWD active‑deposit ratio rose steadily to 62.14% in Q3.

20. Industry concentration is diversified: within the loan book, manufacturing accounts for 22.95% (electronics & information 5.66%), while non‑manufacturing makes up 77.05%, indicating a broadly diversified sector mix.

21. Mortgage business and risk control: new mortgage originations in Q3 totalled NT$32.07 billion with an average loan‑to‑value (LTV) of 64.94%; the overall mortgage portfolio’s average LTV was low at 49% and the average mortgage rate held at 2.32%. Geographically, the North‑Taipei‑Keelung‑Taoyuan region accounted for 63.1% of the portfolio, offering strong collateral liquidity and value preservation.

22. Fee income and operating‑expense ratio: wealth‑management fee income rose 30.8% year‑over‑year to NT$8.54 billion, representing 71.5% of total net fee income (up from 67.4%). Loan‑related fee income also grew 6.6% year‑over‑year. Q3 net fee income was NT$3.945 billion, down 6.5% quarter‑over‑quarter due to a higher Q2 base and heightened market volatility. The three‑quarter operating‑expense ratio fell 0.75 percentage points to 42.26% from 43.01% a year ago.

23. Asset quality and capital adequacy: as of end‑September, the overall non‑performing loan (NPL) ratio held steady at 0.16% and the loan‑loss coverage ratio was 864.09%. Large enterprises maintained a 0% NPL rate, SMEs were at 0.19%, mortgages 0.07%, and personal loans 0.09%. Pre‑tax profit from overseas operations in the first three quarters reached NT$7.62 billion, accounting for 27.46% of total pre‑tax profit, marking a three‑quarter consecutive increase and a recent high. Q3 bank capital adequacy ratio was 14.8%, Tier‑1 capital ratio 12.69%, CET1 11.27%, all above the regulatory thresholds for systemically important banks.
24. 4. Q&A Highlights
25. 2027 Global and Taiwan Economic Outlook
26. Q: 2026 GDP growth was solid and the year is almost over. What is the management’s view on the 2027 global and Taiwan economic outlook? (Combined question)

27. A: Global economy – despite disruptions from the Middle‑East conflict and higher energy prices in 2026, AI‑driven high‑performance computing and cloud‑service investments lifted global GDP growth to an estimated 3.1%. In 2027, energy shocks are expected to ease, and AI capital spending will continue to support recovery, keeping global GDP growth forecast at 3.4%. Taiwan – strong AI and semiconductor‑supply‑chain demand is boosting exports and private investment, allowing Taiwan’s 2026 GDP to potentially exceed 12%. With a very high base, 2027 growth will naturally moderate but remain positive; the in‑house view projects Taiwan’s 2027 growth around 6%.
28. 2027 Loan‑Business Growth Forecast

29. Q: The Q3 2026 presentation showed loan growth of roughly 13% year‑over‑year, matching the double‑digit guidance for this year. What are your expectations and forecasts for loan growth in 2027? (Unified Investment Tina)

30. A: We project First Bank’s total loan growth in 2027 to be about 5%‑6%. The strategy will focus on “selective expansion and capital efficiency,” with an emphasis on SME loans, which are expected to grow around 10%; mortgage loans about 4.5%; and foreign‑currency loans roughly 9%. The bank will continue to target AI‑related semiconductor businesses, high‑yield overseas loan opportunities, and Taiwanese companies investing in the United States.
31. Net‑Interest‑Margin (NIM) and FX‑Swap Income Outlook

32. Q1: This year’s NIM showed a slight decline. How do you view the adjusted NIM (including swaps) level for next year? What is the outlook for swap income? (KGI Securities Eric, Unified Investment Tina)

33. Q2: Swap income is expected to grow next year, but the adjusted NIM appears lower than this year’s forecast. Does this indicate a drop in the underlying NIM and why? Does the forecast already embed US‑Taiwan rate‑policy adjustments? (Unified Investment Tina)
34. Q3: Please confirm the full‑year 2026 adjusted NIM (including swaps) forecast. (KGI Securities Eric)

35. A: 2026 full‑year forecast – after adding swaps, the adjusted NIM is expected to reach 1.0%; FX‑swap income for the first ten months is about NT$9 billion, with a 2026 target of NT$10.5 billion. 2027 full‑year forecast – adjusted NIM (including swaps) could reach 1.02%; a larger US‑rate spread will push swap income targets to NT$12.5‑12.7 billion (≈NT$12.6 billion). Rate‑movement assumptions: last September the Fed cut rates, narrowing foreign‑currency spreads; this September the Fed resumed hikes, and together with AI‑driven funding demand, tighter market liquidity and LCR constraints, funding costs are expected to rise, affecting residual‑funds returns. The forecast already incorporates these rate‑policy assumptions, and we will aim to improve next year’s overall net‑interest income and NIM by raising foreign‑currency deposit ratios, optimizing the TWD‑foreign‑currency deposit mix, strengthening high‑yield asset allocation, and flexibly managing swaps.
36. Fee‑Income and Wealth‑Management Business Outlook

37. Q1: The presentation shows Q3 wealth‑management fee income fell 6.5% quarter‑over‑quarter. Although overall fee income was strong this year, what caused the Q3 dip and what are the expectations for Q4 and next year? (Anonymous)
38. Q2: Looking ahead to 2027, what growth drivers do you anticipate for overall fee income and the wealth‑management business? (Follow‑up)

39. A: Reason for Q3 dip and Q4 outlook – the main cause was heightened global market volatility, which dampened insurance and trust fee income compared with the first half of the year. Q4 is expected to hold at a level similar to Q3. Growth focus and 2027 target – in the second half of this year and next year we will keep concentrating on high‑net‑worth clients and the Asian Asset Management Hub (Asia‑Bay) business, aggressively promoting Lombard lending, premium financing and family‑office services. We project overall fee income to maintain double‑digit growth in 2027, with wealth‑management fee income targeting a 15% increase.
40. SME Asset Quality, Credit Cost and Operating‑Expense Ratio Outlook
41. Q1: The presentation shows the SME NPL ratio rose slightly from Q2. Is there any particular concern about SME NPLs? What caused the increase? (Goldman Sachs Simon)
42. Q2: Credit cost was solid in the first three quarters. Will the full‑year net credit cost be adjusted from the original estimate? What is the net credit‑cost outlook for next year? (Follow‑up)
43. Q3: What is the forecast for next year’s operating‑expense ratio (CI Ratio)? (Unified Investment Tina)

44. A: SME NPLs – large enterprises remain at 0% NPL, while SME NPL rose marginally from 0.18% to 0.19% (a 0.01% increase) due to occasional isolated cases that are small and not systemic; the overall NPL ratio stays at 0.16%, indicating sound asset quality. Net credit cost – the original 2026 full‑year net credit‑cost estimate was 18 bps; as of end‑September the actual figure was 16 bps. The 2027 net credit‑cost is projected to stay at 18 bps. Operating‑expense ratio – expected to be in line with historical levels, around 42%‑43% for 2027.
45. Dividend Distribution Policy

46. Q: Historically the payout ratio has been around 60%, and the 2025 dividend payout ratio reached 69% cash. Is it possible to achieve a similar level for the 2026 dividend, or what is the management’s target? (KGI Securities Eric)

47. A: The company’s dividend policy focuses on cash dividends, with a baseline payout ratio target of at least 60%. The actual payout will also consider subsidiary dividend contributions, next year’s business plans, and capital‑management needs to support growth. The final proposal will be evaluated after the overall 2026 situation is assessed and then submitted to the board for discussion, aiming to reward shareholders’ long‑term support as much as possible.

items.title: 美國空軍核心雲端平台Cloud One遭駭！軍機作戰、彈藥庫存資料恐面臨風險
items.title_en: U.S. Air Force Core Cloud Platform Cloud One Hacked, Threatening Aircraft Operations and Ammunition Inventory Data
paras: 美國空軍核心雲端運算平台Cloud One傳出遭駭客入侵，可能危及軍方敏感的戰術、人事及後勤資料安全。就在這起事件發生數天前，外界才傳出美國中央情報局（CIA）資料庫遭人未經授權存取。
根據《路透》周五（27日）報導，兩名知情人士透露，美國空軍的Cloud One平台約在過去一個月內遭到入侵，事件是在系統升級期間被發現，並已造成平台部分運作受到干擾。
不過，《路透》目前無法確認駭客身分、入侵範圍，以及是否有資料遭到竊取。
美國空軍對此表示，不會評論特定網路與系統的安全狀態、漏洞或運作情況，並強調持續採取適當措施，保護空軍部門的資訊、系統及任務執行能力。
Cloud One是美國空軍整合資訊科技需求的重要平台，負責支援人事資料、薪資、後勤及維修等業務，並由微軟(MSFT-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、甲骨文(ORCL-US) 及Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下Google等四家業者提供雲端管理服務。
不過，Cloud One的用途不僅限於行政作業，也支援軍事指揮與控制，以及戰區整合彈藥管理系統（TICMS），負責追蹤和管理全球超過200個地點的彈藥庫存。
一名知情人士向《路透》表示，這類系統遭入侵是相當嚴重的事件。另一名消息人士指出，入侵者利用軟體漏洞取得控制系統的存取權限，理論上可能藉此查詢軍機的作戰狀態，或掌握備用零件的運送情況。
這起據報發生的入侵事件，正值美國多個政府機構及情報單位接連傳出遭駭客入侵之際，包括聯邦調查局（FBI）、國土安全部的人事資料系統、財政部，以及兩個情報機構。
在五角大廈發生的一起資安事件中，駭客成功存取一套名為「國防人力資料中心」（Defense Manpower Data Center）的系統。一名美國國防官員向《Military.com》透露，這起事件影響276萬名在世人士及29.4萬名已故人士。
根據《Military.com》報導，外洩資料包括社會安全號碼，並依個別人士情況，可能還包含姓名、出生日期、聯絡資訊及軍事職務專長等資料。
本周稍早，另有消息指出，駭客入侵中央情報局及國家情報總監辦公室（ODNI）使用的系統，取得非機密資訊。
《紐約時報》指出，遭入侵的系統是一套情報分析工具，主要掃描公開來源及非機密資料，從中搜尋情報線索與相關資訊。
CIA拒絕對此置評。不過，ODNI發言人透過電子郵件向《彭博》表示：「關鍵能力或機密系統均未受到任何干擾。」
paras_en: The U.S. Air Force’s core cloud‑computing platform Cloud One is reported to have been breached by hackers, potentially endangering the military’s sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data. The incident comes just days after reports that the CIA’s database had been accessed without authorization.

According to Reuters on Friday the 27th, two insiders said the Air Force’s Cloud One platform was infiltrated sometime in the past month. The breach was discovered during a system upgrade and has disrupted parts of the platform’s operation.
Reuters, however, could not verify the hackers’ identity, the scope of the intrusion, or whether any data was stolen.

The Air Force said it would not comment on the security status, vulnerabilities or performance of specific networks and systems, and emphasized that it continues to take appropriate measures to protect its information, systems and mission‑execution capability.

Cloud One is a key platform that consolidates the Air Force’s IT needs, supporting personnel records, payroll, logistics and maintenance, and is managed by cloud services from Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Oracle (ORCL‑US) and Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL‑US).

Beyond administrative functions, Cloud One also supports military command and control and the Theater Integrated Ammunition Management System (TICMS), which tracks and manages ammunition stocks at more than 200 locations worldwide.

An insider told Reuters that a breach of this type of system is a serious event. Another source said the intruders exploited a software vulnerability to gain control‑system access, theoretically allowing them to query aircraft operational status or monitor the shipment of spare parts.

The reported intrusion occurs amid a wave of cyber‑attacks on multiple U.S. government agencies and intelligence bodies, including the FBI, the Department of Homeland Security’s personnel database, the Treasury Department and two intelligence agencies.

In a separate Pentagon cyber incident, hackers accessed a system called the Defense Manpower Data Center. A U.S. defense official told Military.com that the breach affected 2.76 million living individuals and 294,000 deceased persons.

Military.com reported that the leaked data included Social Security numbers and, depending on the individual, could also contain names, dates of birth, contact information and military occupational specialties.
Earlier this week, reports emerged that hackers had penetrated systems used by the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, obtaining non‑classified information.
The New York Times noted that the compromised system was an intelligence‑analysis tool that primarily scans open‑source and unclassified data to hunt for intelligence leads and related information.
The CIA declined to comment. However, an ODNI spokesperson emailed Bloomberg stating that “no critical capabilities or classified systems were impacted.”

items.title_en: A Feather in the Wind! Listing Status to Be Cancelled, Evergrande Auto’s Dream of Building Cars Ends in Ruin
paras: 九年造車大夢、千億資金（人民幣，下同）沉沒，中國恆大汽車最終恐以「一地雞毛」收場。
恆大汽車27日晚在港交所公告，稱聯交所上市委員會已決定根據有關規定取消公司上市地位，原因為上市委員會認為公司未能於2026年9月30日復牌截止時間達成所有復牌指引。
「根據上市規則2B章，公司有權於除牌決定發出日期起計七個營業日內，將除牌決定提交上市覆核委員會覆核。倘公司決定不要求進行上市覆核委員會覆核，則股份的最後上市日期將為2026年12月11日，而股份的上市地位將於2026年12月14日上午9時正起取消。」
據《財聯社》28日報導，恆大汽車在公告中說，董事會正在徵詢顧問的意見，考慮是否請求聯交所上市覆核委員會覆核除牌決定。董事謹此提醒股東及潛在投資者，上市覆核委員會覆核的結果並不確定。
「公司將於適當時候及根據上市規則的規定作出進一步公告。股東如對股份取消上市地位之影響有任何疑問，應尋求適當的專業意見。公司將於適當時候就覆核作出進一步公告。」恆大汽車說。
2025年4月1日，因未能發布2024年年報，恆大汽車停牌至今。按照港交所規則，恆大汽車停牌18個月到2026年9月底，不復牌即需退市。
恆大汽車踩在最後期限，一口氣發布4份財報。恆大汽車在9月17日公布2024年度業績、2025年中期業績、2025年度業績及2026年中期業績等財報。
2026年半年報顯示，截至6月底，恆大汽車資產總額約1.82億元，負債總額約327.22億元，其中借款約162.83億元、貿易及其他應付款164.39億元。
恆大汽車收入為約900萬元，毛利約50萬元；溢利淨額約1.86億元，較一年前增加約7.71億元。
paras_en: A nine‑year dream of building cars and a trillion‑yuan fund (RMB) have sunk, and China’s Evergrande Auto may finally end in a "feather in the wind" scenario.

Evergrande Auto announced on the night of the 27th that the Hong Kong Stock Exchange’s Listing Committee has decided, pursuant to the relevant rules, to cancel the company’s listing status because the Committee believes the company failed to meet all reinstatement guidelines by the September 30, 2026 deadline.

According to Listing Rule 2B, the company has the right, within seven business days of the delisting decision date, to submit the delisting decision to the Listing Review Committee for review. If the company decides not to request a review, the final listing date of the shares will be December 11, 2026, and the listing status will be cancelled at 9:00 a.m. on December 14, 2026.

The China Financial News Agency reported on the 28th that Evergrande Auto said in the announcement that the board is consulting advisors on whether to request a review of the delisting decision by the Listing Review Committee. The directors remind shareholders and potential investors that the outcome of such a review is uncertain.

Evergrande Auto added that it will make further announcements at the appropriate time in accordance with the listing rules. Shareholders who have any questions about the impact of the cancellation of the listing status should seek appropriate professional advice, and the company will issue further notices on the review when appropriate.

Evergrande Auto has been suspended since April 1, 2025 for failing to publish its 2024 annual report. Under HKEX rules, the suspension lasts 18 months until the end of September 2026; if the shares are not reinstated by then, delisting is required.

Facing the final deadline, Evergrande Auto rushed out four financial reports at once, publishing its 2024 annual results, 2025 interim results, 2025 annual results and 2026 interim results on September 17.

The 2026 interim report shows that as of the end of June, Evergrande Auto’s total assets were about RMB 1.82 billion, total liabilities about RMB 327.22 billion, including borrowings of roughly RMB 162.83 billion and trade and other payables of RMB 164.39 billion.

Evergrande Auto recorded revenue of about RMB 9 million, gross profit of roughly RMB 0.5 million, and net profit of about RMB 186 million, an increase of approximately RMB 7.71 billion compared with a year earlier.

items.title: 熱門股〉貿聯-KY獲利創高、展望正向 投信11月來大買力挺周漲29%
items.title_en: Hot Stock > Maolian-KY Posts Record Profit, Outlook Positive; Mutual Funds Ramp Up Buying in November Supporting 29% Weekly Gain
paras: 連接線大廠貿聯-KY(3665-TW)獲利創高、展望維持正向，雖然遭到外資連續多日調節，但投信積極承接，連12個交易日買超共1.08萬張，11月以來更僅有1日賣超，近1個月總計買超1.26萬張，也帶動貿聯股價本周跌深反彈，周漲29%。
貿聯第三季稅後純益42.93億元，季增44%、年增63.33%，每股純益21.83元，創單季歷史新高；累計前三季稅後純益95.49億元，年增52.41%，每股純益48.77元，創同期歷史新高，並超越去年全年。
展望2027年，執行長鄧劍華表示，雖然技術世代更替、客戶部署時程及產能瓶頸仍可能帶來波動，但看好高效能運算(HPC)、半導體設備(SPE)及集團整體產品組合的長期成長機會，將持續深化布局，投入下一世代銅纜、光纖解決方案，以及更精密的電力與連接傳輸產品。
鄧劍華指出，隨著客戶拓展新應用及新市場，貿聯將深化跨國及跨區域合作，整合全球專業知識與製造資源，提升承接大型專案的能力；在營運策略上，除追求規模成長，也將重視投資報酬及資本紀律，將技術實力與營運規模轉化為更高獲利、資本運用效率及穩定現金流。
paras_en: Maolian-KY (3665-TW), a major connector manufacturer, posted record earnings and maintained a positive outlook. Although foreign investors trimmed positions for several consecutive days, mutual funds stepped in aggressively, net buying 10,800 contracts over 12 trading days. Since November, they have recorded only one day of net selling, and over the past month they net bought 12,600 contracts, helping the stock rebound sharply after a deep dip, delivering a 29% gain for the week.

In the third quarter, Maolian reported after‑tax net profit of NT$4.293 billion, up 44% quarter‑over‑quarter and 63.33% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$21.83 – a historic quarterly high. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, after‑tax net profit reached NT$9.549 billion, a 52.41% increase year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$48.77, also a record for the same period and surpassing the full‑year result of the prior year.

Looking ahead to 2027, CEO Deng Jianhua said that while technology cycles, customer deployment schedules and capacity bottlenecks may still cause volatility, the company is optimistic about long‑term growth opportunities in high‑performance computing (HPC), semiconductor equipment (SPE) and the group’s overall product portfolio. Maolian will continue deepening its positioning, investing in next‑generation copper cables, fiber‑optic solutions, and more precise power and transmission products.

Deng added that as customers expand into new applications and markets, Maolian will deepen cross‑border and cross‑regional collaborations, integrating global expertise and manufacturing resources to boost its ability to handle large projects. Strategically, beyond pursuing scale growth, the firm will emphasize investment returns and capital discipline, converting technical strength and operational scale into higher profitability, more efficient capital use, and stable cash flow.

items.title: OpenAI反擊蘋果！控施壓供應商、限制員工跳槽  阻撓進軍AI硬體市場
items.title_en: OpenAI Strikes Back at Apple! Pressuring Suppliers and Restricting Employee Moves to Hinder AI Hardware Push
paras: OpenAI與蘋果(AAPL-US) 之間的商業機密訴訟再度升級。OpenAI最新提出反訴，指控蘋果利用對供應商的影響力，施壓業者不得與OpenAI合作，還透過限制性聘僱協議阻止工程師跳槽，妨礙OpenAI延攬人才，試圖阻止這家人工智慧（AI）公司進軍硬體市場。
根據《彭博》報導，OpenAI周五（27日）向美國加州聖荷西聯邦法院提出反訴，除指控蘋果不公平限制供應商與人才流動，也反控蘋果竊取OpenAI的商業機密，使原本由蘋果提起的訴訟，演變成雙方針對智慧財產權的法律攻防。
這場訴訟正值OpenAI準備跨足硬體市場之際。OpenAI正與蘋果前設計主管艾夫（Jony Ive）合作開發一系列硬體產品，首款產品預計是一款甜甜圈造型的智慧音箱。
OpenAI在反訴文件中指出，蘋果面對OpenAI可能進軍硬體市場，採取不當手段向供應商施壓，要求業者不要與OpenAI合作，同時利用範圍過於廣泛的聘僱限制，阻礙OpenAI取得優秀工程人才。OpenAI認為，蘋果不能利用對供應商及工程師的影響力，排除市場上的競爭者。
蘋果今年7月已對OpenAI及該公司硬體主管Tang Tan提起訴訟，指控OpenAI透過招募蘋果員工及延攬離職員工，策劃竊取商業機密。雙方過去曾合作，將ChatGPT整合至iPhone、iPad及Mac軟體，但近來合作關係逐漸降溫。
蘋果當時指控，OpenAI員工曾利用一台遭竊的蘋果公司筆電存取內部資料，並利用一項罕見、先前未被發現的身分驗證漏洞，進入蘋果內部共享網路。蘋果還稱，OpenAI曾要求仍在蘋果任職的求職者，在面試時帶來蘋果產品的「實際零件」。
對於OpenAI提出的反訴，蘋果反駁稱，這只是試圖轉移外界對原訴訟焦點的注意力，並強調法院已要求OpenAI停止使用蘋果機密資訊。
蘋果在聲明中表示，案件核心在於OpenAI員工蓄意竊取、訪問及使用蘋果尚未發布的技術、流程與產品機密，而非意外保留蘋果資訊。
OpenAI則進一步指控，蘋果要求產業供應商揭露與OpenAI合作的專案內容，以及具有蘋果工作經驗的員工姓名、工作地點與職務安排。OpenAI稱，蘋果隨後會設法阻止曾參與OpenAI專案的員工繼續為蘋果工作，變相讓供應商不敢派遣人力支援OpenAI。
反訴文件還指出，一家提供專業表面加工服務的供應商，為避免與蘋果的工作時段重疊，將OpenAI產品的製造作業改至夜班，導致OpenAI成本增加。OpenAI認為，供應商是受到蘋果施壓才做出這項調整。
OpenAI表示，部分供應商擔心失去蘋果訂單，因此刻意調整與OpenAI的會議時間，避免讓蘋果察覺合作關係；另有供應商告訴OpenAI，必須謹慎分配員工、產能及管理資源。
除了供應鏈問題，OpenAI也將矛頭指向蘋果的員工聘僱協議，質疑相關條款限制人才流動。OpenAI特別挑戰蘋果禁止離職員工在一年內招攬或招聘現職員工的規定。
OpenAI認為，蘋果要求員工簽署的智慧財產權協議（IPA），對公司機密資訊的定義過於寬泛，幾乎涵蓋員工在職期間接觸到的所有非公開資訊，即使相關內容並不構成商業機密，也受到限制。OpenAI主張，這些條款不合理地限制離職員工運用自身專業技能，還讓他們面臨遭蘋果提告的風險。
另一方面，OpenAI也在反訴中提出另一項商業機密爭議，指控一名前蘋果員工離職加入OpenAI，之後又返回蘋果任職期間，曾將超過100份高度機密文件傳送至個人帳戶。這些文件據稱涉及至少一款尚未發布的OpenAI裝置，內容包括未公開硬體圖片、工程與製造資料，以及供應商資訊。
蘋果則表示，公司設有相關政策，禁止員工使用前雇主的機密資料，且內部調查並未發現證據支持OpenAI的指控。
OpenAI否認蘋果提出的竊密指控，並已要求法官駁回蘋果的訴訟。今年10月，法官表示可能發布命令，要求OpenAI停止使用蘋果聲稱遭竊的商業機密後，OpenAI已主動同意不再使用相關資料。
蘋果原先提起的訴訟還點名一名前iPhone工程師 Chang Liu。他今年1月加入OpenAI，蘋果指控他在開發OpenAI硬體產品期間，利用發現的身分驗證漏洞，在數周內存取蘋果機密硬體文件。

paras_en: OpenAI and Apple (AAPL-US) have escalated their trade‑secret lawsuit. OpenAI has filed a counter‑claim accusing Apple of using its influence over suppliers to pressure them not to work with OpenAI, and of employing restrictive hiring agreements to block engineers from moving, thereby hampering OpenAI’s talent recruitment and trying to stop the AI company from entering the hardware market.

According to Bloomberg, OpenAI filed the counter‑claim on Friday (the 27th) in the U.S. District Court in San Jose, California, alleging that Apple unfairly limits supplier and talent mobility and also accusing Apple of stealing OpenAI’s trade secrets, turning the original Apple‑filed suit into a two‑sided intellectual‑property battle.

The lawsuit comes as OpenAI prepares to move into hardware. The company is working with former Apple design chief Jony Ive to develop a line of hardware products, with the first expected to be a donut‑shaped smart speaker.

In the counter‑claim, OpenAI says Apple, fearing OpenAI’s entry into hardware, has improperly pressured suppliers to refuse cooperation and has used overly broad employment restrictions to block OpenAI from hiring top engineers. OpenAI argues Apple cannot use its sway over suppliers and engineers to eliminate competition.

Apple sued OpenAI and its hardware head Tang Tan in July, alleging OpenAI recruited Apple staff and poached former employees to steal trade secrets. The two firms previously collaborated to integrate ChatGPT into iPhone, iPad and Mac software, but the partnership has cooled recently.

Apple alleged that an OpenAI employee accessed internal data using a stolen Apple laptop and exploited a rare, previously unknown authentication vulnerability to enter Apple’s internal network. Apple also said OpenAI asked job candidates still employed at Apple to bring actual Apple components to interviews.
Apple rebuffed OpenAI’s counter‑claim, saying it is an attempt to distract from the original case and noting the court has ordered OpenAI to stop using Apple’s confidential information.

In its statement, Apple said the core issue is that OpenAI employees deliberately stole, accessed and used Apple’s unreleased technology, processes and product secrets, not that they inadvertently retained Apple information.

OpenAI further alleges Apple demanded that industry suppliers disclose the details of any projects they were working on with OpenAI, as well as the names, locations and roles of employees with Apple experience. OpenAI says Apple then tried to prevent those employees from continuing to work for Apple, effectively deterring suppliers from supporting OpenAI.

The counter‑claim notes that a supplier providing specialized surface‑finishing services shifted OpenAI production to night shifts to avoid overlapping with Apple work, raising OpenAI’s costs. OpenAI says the supplier made the change only because of Apple’s pressure.

OpenAI says some suppliers, fearing loss of Apple orders, deliberately altered meeting times with OpenAI to keep the partnership hidden from Apple, while other suppliers told OpenAI they must carefully allocate staff, capacity and management resources.

Beyond supply‑chain issues, OpenAI also targets Apple’s employee agreements, questioning clauses that restrict talent mobility. OpenAI specifically challenges Apple’s rule that former employees may not solicit or hire current staff for one year after leaving.

OpenAI argues Apple’s Intellectual Property Agreement (IPA) defines confidential information so broadly that it covers virtually all non‑public information an employee encounters, even when that information does not constitute a trade secret, and that the clauses unreasonably limit former employees’ use of their skills and expose them to litigation risk from Apple.

In another trade‑secret dispute raised in the counter‑claim, OpenAI alleges a former Apple employee who left for OpenAI and later returned to Apple transmitted more than 100 highly confidential documents to a personal account. The files allegedly relate to at least one unreleased OpenAI device and include unpublished hardware images, engineering and manufacturing data, and supplier information.
Apple says it has policies prohibiting employees from using former employers’ confidential data and that its internal investigation found no evidence supporting OpenAI’s allegations.

OpenAI denies Apple’s theft accusations and has asked the judge to dismiss Apple’s suit. In October, the judge indicated a possible order requiring OpenAI to stop using the allegedly stolen Apple trade secrets, and OpenAI voluntarily agreed to cease using the material.

Apple’s original suit also singled out former iPhone engineer Chang Liu, who joined OpenAI in January. Apple alleges that while developing OpenAI hardware, Liu used a discovered authentication vulnerability to access Apple’s confidential hardware documents over several weeks.

items.title: 《彭博》輝達高階晶片現蹤上海！黃樂關係企業涉入、Blackwell設備成銀行抵押品
items.title_en: Bloomberg Reports Nvidia's High-End Chips Appearing in Shanghai! Huang Le-Related Enterprises Involved, Blackwell Equipment Used as Bank Collateral
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 最先進的Blackwell系列晶片疑似流入中國，再度引發外界對高階人工智慧（AI）晶片走私問題的關注。根據《彭博》周五報導，輝達最強大的Blackwell系列處理器，已出現在上海一座與黃樂（Alice Huang）有關聯的資料中心內。黃樂是一名常駐新加坡的商人，也是輝達晶片走私爭議的核心人物。
根據報導，提交給中國監管機構的文件顯示，兩家中國企業已在上海大型資料中心「長三角計畫」（Yangtze River Delta Project）部署搭載Blackwell晶片的硬體。
上海碩曜科技（Shanghai Shuoyao）以一套GB300 NVL72伺服器機櫃作為抵押品，向上海創新銀行取得人民幣9,600萬元（約1,400萬美元）貸款。
另一家企業上海科棧（Shanghai Kezhan）則在申請人民幣9,000萬元貸款的相關文件中，揭露其在同一地點設有一台GB200伺服器。提供這筆貸款的融資租賃公司由上海一家地方政府機構全資持有。
Blackwell系列晶片一直受到美國出口管制，未經美國政府許可不得出口至中國。美國總統川普也曾表明，不希望這類高階晶片流入中國。
輝達執行長黃仁勳過去則曾表示，相關設備體積龐大，難以走私，並指出標準規格的GB300 NVL72伺服器機櫃重量超過1,500公斤，高度約2公尺。
《彭博》將文件所載的產品序號輸入公開保固資料庫後，確認這套GB300機櫃由台灣技嘉(2376-TW) 製造。技嘉負責將輝達晶片組裝成伺服器及機櫃。
上海碩耀本月證實，該公司是Megaspeed的服務供應商，並將雙方關係描述為「僅限於一般商業合作」。
Megaspeed由黃樂於2023年創立，本月遭川普政府列入美國貿易黑名單。美國政府指出，該公司涉及晶片轉運的風險重大。Megaspeed則否認有任何不法行為。
黃樂與多家投資長三角資料中心計畫的企業有所關聯。知情人士透露，該資料中心董事長康偉（Kang Wei）有時被介紹為黃樂的丈夫。
上海科棧有83.3%的股權由日本NeXPower持有，該公司總部位於東京。中國財經媒體曾報導，NeXPower由黃樂控制。其餘16.7%股權則由中國遊戲公司第七大道(00797-HK)旗下子公司持有，而第七大道正是Megaspeed最初的母公司。
根據Big Trade Data的紀錄，上海科棧於2025年5月接收一批價值1,100萬美元的貨物，從馬來西亞空運至上海浦東國際機場。
海關文件將這批貨物描述為「儲存機箱」，但其申報的商品編碼847150實則代表「運算伺服器」，且每台單價高達26萬4,108美元，落在搭載輝達Hopper系列晶片伺服器的價格範圍內。
監管文件還顯示，上海創新銀行曾另外向上海龍捷（Shanghai Longjie）提供人民幣2億元貸款。上海龍捷與上海碩曜隸屬同一母公司，並以搭載受到出口限制的輝達Hopper世代晶片的設備作為貸款抵押品。
這些硬體由美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 及戴爾科技(DELL-US) 製造。目前尚不清楚相關設備運往中國時，是否取得美國政府許可。

paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US)’s most advanced Blackwell series chips appear to have entered China, reigniting concerns over the smuggling of high‑end artificial intelligence (AI) chips. According to Bloomberg’s Friday report, Nvidia’s flagship Blackwell processors have surfaced in a data centre in Shanghai linked to Alice Huang, a Singapore‑based businessman who is a central figure in the Nvidia chip smuggling controversy.

The report shows that documents filed with Chinese regulators indicate that two Chinese companies have deployed hardware equipped with Blackwell chips in the Shanghai data centre known as the Yangtze River Delta Project.
Shanghai Shuoyao used a GB300 NVL72 server rack as collateral to obtain a loan of 96 million yuan (about 14 million U.S. dollars) from Shanghai Innovation Bank.

Another company, Shanghai Kezhan, disclosed in its loan application documents for 90 million yuan that it has a GB200 server at the same site; the financing lease company providing the loan is wholly owned by a local government entity in Shanghai.

The Blackwell series has been subject to U.S. export controls, and it may not be exported to China without U.S. government approval. President Trump has also stated that he does not want such high‑end chips to flow into China.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang previously said that the equipment is too large to smuggle, noting that a standard GB300 NVL72 server rack weighs over 1,500 kg and is about 2 m tall.

Bloomberg entered the serial numbers listed in the documents into a public warranty database and confirmed that the GB300 rack was manufactured by Taiwanese Gigabyte (2376‑TW). Gigabyte assembles Nvidia chips into servers and racks.
Shanghai Shuoyao confirmed this month that it is a service provider for Megaspeed and described its relationship with the company as "limited to general commercial cooperation."

Megaspeed was founded by Huang Le in 2023 and was added to the U.S. trade blacklist by the Trump administration this month. The U.S. government said the company poses a significant risk of chip transshipment, while Megaspeed denies any wrongdoing.

Huang Le is linked to several companies investing in the Yangtze River Delta data centre project. An insider revealed that the centre’s chairman, Kang Wei, is sometimes introduced as Huang Le’s husband.

Shanghai Kezhan is 83.3% owned by Japan’s NeXPower, headquartered in Tokyo. Chinese financial media have reported that NeXPower is controlled by Huang Le. The remaining 16.7% is owned by a subsidiary of the Chinese gaming company Seventh Avenue (00797‑HK), which was originally the parent company of Megaspeed.
According to Big Trade Data, Shanghai Kezhan received a shipment worth 11 million U.S. dollars in May 2025, air‑freighted from Malaysia to Shanghai Pudong International Airport.

Customs documents described the shipment as "storage cases," but the declared HS code 847150 actually represents "computing servers," and each unit was priced at $264,108, within the price range of servers equipped with Nvidia Hopper series chips.

Regulatory filings also show that Shanghai Innovation Bank provided an additional loan of 200 million yuan to Shanghai Longjie. Shanghai Longjie is part of the same parent company as Shanghai Shuoyao and used equipment with export‑restricted Nvidia Hopper generation chips as collateral.
The hardware was manufactured by Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) and Dell Technologies (DELL-US). It is unclear whether the equipment obtained U.S. government approval when shipped to China.

items.title: 景碩601.7億元ABF擴產案獲准既有產線近滿載、首波增量看2027年中
items.title_en: JingShuo's NT$60.17 billion ABF Expansion Project Approved; Existing Lines Near Full Capacity, First Increment Expected Mid‑2027
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 經濟部投資台灣事務所27日通過景碩(3189-TW)擴大投資案。景碩規劃投入新台幣601.7億元擴建北部廠區、添購設備，以增加高階ABF載板產能，預計增聘1,074人。
景碩24日在法說會表示，現有ABF載板產能利用率約95%，再靠加班也難以增加產出。依公司先前規劃，第六廠區A棟已量產，B棟預計2027年中接棒，C、D棟則分別於2028年及2029年開出。這次獲准的投資案未另列投產時程，近期出貨能否放大，仍要看B棟能否如期投產。
輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)的合作案則有另一個時程。景碩18日宣布，輝達將投入逾10億美元購置桃園幼獅廠設備，以取得2027年下半年以後的載板供應。依輝達公布的規劃，這批專供輝達的先進ABF產線預計2027年下半年開始生產，目標於2028年第三季達到規劃產能。

paras_en: November 28, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – The Investment Promotion Office of the Ministry of Economic Affairs approved JingShuo's (3189‑TW) expansion investment on the 27th. JingShuo plans to invest NT$60.17 billion to expand its northern plant and purchase new equipment, boosting high‑end ABF substrate capacity and creating an estimated 1,074 new jobs.

At its earnings conference on the 24th, JingShuo said the current utilization rate of its ABF substrate capacity is about 95%, and even overtime cannot increase output further. According to the company's prior plan, the A building of the sixth plant has already entered mass production, the B building is slated to take over in mid‑2027, while the C and D buildings are scheduled for 2028 and 2029 respectively. The approved investment does not specify a commissioning timeline, so whether shipments can be scaled up soon depends on the B building being commissioned on schedule.

NVIDIA's (NVDA‑US) collaboration follows a different timeline. JingShuo announced on the 18th that NVIDIA will invest over US$1 billion to purchase equipment for its Taoyuan Young Lion plant, securing substrate supply after the second half of 2027. According to NVIDIA's disclosed plan, the advanced ABF production line dedicated to NVIDIA is expected to start production in the second half of 2027, aiming to reach planned capacity by the third quarter of 2028.

items.title: 聯電新加坡矽光子擴產推進亞翔集團承接367.64億元廠務工程及設備
items.title_en: UMC's Singapore Silicon-Photon Expansion Advances; Yaxiang Group Wins NT$367.64 billion Plant Construction and Equipment Contracts
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 聯電(2303-TW)新加坡12吋晶圓廠第四期（P4）擴建推進至廠務採購。聯電27日公告一筆廠房工程及兩筆廠務設備交易，依公告金額加總約新台幣367.64億元，交易對象均為亞翔(6139-TW)旗下公司。
亞翔全資新加坡子公司L&K Engineering承接約13.72億元的廠房工程及183.76億元的廠務設備，兩筆合計約197.47億元。另一筆約170.16億元的廠務設備由凌邁智（LIMK Engineering）承接，占三筆交易總額約46%。凌邁智是蘇州亞翔的全資子公司，亞翔持有蘇州亞翔53.99%股權。
聯電7月表示，新加坡P4廠房外殼已完工，接下來將建置無塵室並添購設備，以擴充矽光子產能。這次公告的三筆交易涵蓋廠房工程及廠務設備，其中凌邁智的設備採購交易期間自6月16日起。

paras_en: On November 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC, 2303‑TW) is moving the fourth phase (P4) expansion of its 12‑inch wafer fab in Singapore into the plant‑procurement stage. On the 27th, UMC announced a plant‑construction project and two plant‑equipment deals totaling approximately NT$367.64 billion, all with companies under Yaxiang Group (6139‑TW).

Yaxiang’s wholly‑owned Singapore subsidiary L&K Engineering will handle a plant‑construction contract worth about NT$13.72 billion and plant‑equipment purchases of NT$183.76 billion, together amounting to roughly NT$197.47 billion. Another plant‑equipment contract of about NT$170.16 billion will be undertaken by LIMK Engineering, accounting for about 46% of the total value of the three deals. LIMK Engineering is a wholly‑owned subsidiary of Suzhou Yaxiang, in which Yaxiang holds a 53.99% stake.

UMC said in July that the exterior shell of the Singapore P4 fab has been completed, and the next steps are to build the cleanroom and acquire equipment to boost silicon‑photon capacity. The three announced transactions cover both construction and equipment, with the LIMK Engineering equipment procurement period starting on June 16.
