items.title: 伸興、程泰集團達成董事提名共識 程泰獲1席
items.title_en: Shin Sheng and Cheng Tai Group Reach Consensus on Board Nomination; Cheng Tai Secures One Seat
paras: 全球縫紉機製造大廠伸興(1558-TW)因應今年度全體董事改選，於27日正式公告新任董事(含獨立董事)候選人名單，經與程泰集團理性協商，雙方已就本次股東臨時會董事提名安排達成共識。雙方同意以公司長期發展及全體股東權益為共同目標，透過良性溝通與合作，為公司未來經營與公司治理建立穩健基礎。
依雙方達成之共識，本次董事提名安排為，伸興提名三名一般董事候選人，分別為林志誠、蔡崇廷、廖樹城；提名三名獨立董事候選人，分別為黃惠玉、許永聲、施芸婷；程泰提名一名一般董事候選人，為弘華投資股份有限公司代表人王丞軒。
雙方將依相關法令及公司章程規定，辦理後續董事選舉及相關程序。
伸興表示，公司始終秉持誠信經營、穩健發展及股東權益優先的理念，持續致力於提升經營績效、強化公司治理及創造長期企業價值。此次雙方透過理性溝通與協商取得共識，展現各方對公司長期發展的重視，也有助於凝聚股東力量，為公司未來經營與治理奠定穩健基礎。
伸興表示，程泰集團為台灣工具機龍頭品牌，具備行銷全球的亮眼實績，而伸興集團亦是全球縫紉機的領導廠商。程泰集團加入伸興董事會後，未來無論是在公司治理、精實生產、行銷策略方面雙方都可深化合作，交流互惠，在經營績效方面共創雙贏。
伸興表示，公司長期深化ESG與維護股東權益，且與所有支持伸興的重要股東保持暢通溝通，這也是伸興在公司治理評鑒晉升「6%至20%」前段班行列的關鍵原因。本次董事候選人名單是基於公司未來全球布局與智慧自動化轉型的戰略需求，在既有的強大製造與研發基礎上，廣納各方專業意見後所提出的最佳陣容，以全體股東最大利益為依歸。
而在獨立董事專業上，伸興仍提名具備財務會計、法律合規及產業管理等多元專業背景，落實公司治理，且完全符合主管機關對上市櫃公司董事會多元化與獨立性之高標準要求。未來新任董事會成立後，將能以更客觀、前瞻的視角審視公司重大資本支出、全球產能布局及永續經營（ESG）策略，進一步提升公司治理透明度。
伸興指出，面對全球供應鏈重組與智慧製造浪潮，企業需要無可取代的全球交付能力與核心技術，以及更具備戰略高度與跨界資源的治理團隊。本次董事候選人名單的提出，展現伸興以行業領導者之姿，積極整合內外部優勢資源、持續擴大競爭護城河的決心。伸興未來將繼續深化核心技術研發，並提升全球營運效率，以亮眼的營運實績，回饋所有股東與合作夥伴。
paras_en: Shin Sheng (1558-TW), a global leader in sewing machine manufacturing, announced on the 27th the list of new board (including independent directors) candidates in response to this year’s full board election. After rational negotiations with Cheng Tai Group, both parties have reached a consensus on the board nominations for the upcoming shareholders’ special meeting. They agree to pursue the company’s long‑term development and the interests of all shareholders as a common goal, using constructive communication and cooperation to lay a solid foundation for future operations and corporate governance.

According to the agreement, Shin Sheng will nominate three ordinary director candidates—Lin Chih‑cheng, Tsai Chong‑ting, and Liao Shu‑cheng—and three independent director candidates—Huang Hui‑yu, Hsu Yung‑sheng, and Shih Yun‑ting. Cheng Tai will nominate one ordinary director candidate, Wang Cheng‑hsuan, representing Honghua Investment Co., Ltd.
Both sides will follow applicable laws and the company’s articles of incorporation to carry out the subsequent director election and related procedures.

Shin Sheng stated that the company consistently upholds the principles of integrity, steady growth, and prioritizing shareholder rights, continuously striving to improve performance, strengthen governance, and create long‑term corporate value. The consensus reached through rational dialogue demonstrates each party’s commitment to the company’s long‑term development and helps unite shareholder support, establishing a robust foundation for future management and governance.

Shin Sheng noted that Cheng Tai Group is Taiwan’s leading brand in machine tools with impressive global marketing achievements, while Shin Sheng is a worldwide leader in sewing machines. With Cheng Tai joining the board, both parties can deepen cooperation in governance, lean production, and marketing strategies, fostering mutual benefit and a win‑win in operational performance.

Shin Sheng emphasized its ongoing commitment to ESG and protecting shareholder interests, maintaining open communication with all key shareholders—a key factor in its advancement to the top tier of corporate‑governance ratings (from 6% to 20%). The board candidate list reflects the strategic needs of global expansion and smart‑automation transformation, drawing on a strong manufacturing and R&D base and diverse professional input to serve the greatest benefit of all shareholders.

Regarding independent directors, Shin Sheng continues to nominate individuals with diverse expertise in finance, accounting, legal compliance, and industry management, meeting the high standards for board diversity and independence set by regulators. Once the new board is formed, it will review major capital expenditures, global capacity planning, and ESG strategies with greater objectivity and foresight, further enhancing governance transparency.

Shin Sheng pointed out that amid global supply‑chain restructuring and the wave of smart manufacturing, companies need irreplaceable global delivery capabilities, core technologies, and a governance team with strategic depth and cross‑industry resources. The proposed board slate demonstrates Shin Sheng’s resolve, as an industry leader, to integrate internal and external strengths, expand its competitive moat, deepen core technology R&D, and improve global operational efficiency, delivering strong performance to shareholders and partners.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉AI重點筆記2026/11/27
items.title_en: First Financial Holding Investor Presentation – AI Highlights (2026/11/27)
paras: 一、營運亮點
金控獲利創同期新高：2026 年前三季金控稅後淨利達 262.25 億元，年增 26.9%，EPS 為 1.82 元。旗艦子公司第一銀行獲利達 232 億元（年增 13%）續創新高；非銀行子公司獲利合計達 40 億元超越往年新高，占金控獲利比重由以往不到 9% 提高至 14% 以上，獲利結構更趨多元穩健。
銀行核心業務雙位數成長：受惠放款穩健擴張，一銀淨利息收入年增 14.6%；資本市場熱絡帶動財富管理手續費收入大增 30.8%，推升整體淨手收年增 23.3%。
企業融資需求熱絡：在 AI 相關產業投資與營運資金需求帶動下，一銀總放款年增 12.9%。其中外幣放款及大企業放款均呈雙位數年成長；中小企業放款突破 1 兆元（年增 8%）穩居市場領先；房貸亦穩健成長 5.8%。
推動公股投信整併：金控董事會已於 10 月 22 日通過推動公股投信整併案，未來將由第一金投信擔任存續公司，打造國家級資產管理平台，整合各方通路、產品及投研資源以深化營運規模與市場競爭優勢。
二、金控財務概要與各子公司表現
金控財務指標全面提升：2026 年前三季總資產穩健成長 9.5%，每股淨值提升 9.4% 至 21.5 元。平均淨值報酬率（ROE）由去年同期的 10.01% 大幅提升至 11.61%，平均資產報酬率（ROA）由 0.57% 升至 0.67%。集團資本適足率維持 124.16% 高水準，雙重槓桿比率穩健控制在 114.5%。
合併損益爆發力強勁：前三季合併淨收益年增 16.9% 至 626 億元；在信用成本與營業費用控管得宜下，稅後淨利年增 26.9% 至 262 億元，加上其他綜合損益挹注，合併綜合損益達 389 億元。
各子公司稅後淨利表現：
第一金證券：稅後淨利提升至 20 億元，年增率高達 165.2%。
第一金人壽：受惠投資收益亮眼及接軌 IFRS 17 後體質良好，稅後淨利由去年同期的 0.76 億元躍升至 6.48 億元。
第一金投信：獲利年增 120.5% 達 2.91 億元。
第一金 AMC 及第一金創投：亦分別繳出強勁的獲利成長表現。
年化 ROE 表現優於過往：金控前三季累積淨利已接近 2025 年全年水準，今年以來年化 ROE 維持在 11% 以上（優於過去兩年 9.6% 至 10.8% 區間）；一銀第三季年化 ROE 達 9.79%，亦優於去年同期的 9.55% 及全年的 8.79%。
三、第一銀行業務表現
稅前獲利結構：前三季累積淨收益達 545.7 億元，年增 9.0%。儘管金融商品收益微減，但兩大核心淨利收（年增 14.6% 達 261 億元）與淨手收（年增 23.3% 達 119 億元）完全彌補缺口；呆帳費用及相關手收費用與去年同期相當，營業費用則隨業務成長適度增加 7%。
放款規模跨越 3 兆元：截至 9 月底總放款餘額由去年同期的 2.7 兆元跨越至 3.09 兆元，年增 12.9%。其中外幣放款年增 22.5%、大企業放款年增 17.2%、中小企業放款年增 8% 達 1 兆 721 億元（蟬聯市場領導地位）。第三季單季放款大增 1,472 億元（季增 5%），全業務皆呈季正成長。

存放比與存放利差（NIM）：整體存放比由去年同期的 70.34% 升至第三季的 74.46%（台幣 88.6%、外幣 46.4%）；前三季存放利差為 1.18%，NIM 為 0.75%。第三季台幣放款利率增 1 點至 2.37%、存款利率 1.08%，台幣利差升 1 點至 1.29%；外幣放款與存款利率分別季增 10 點與 11 點，外幣利差增 1 點至 1.96%，惟受外幣存放比 46.4% 及貨幣市場資金略緊影響，第三季整體 NIM 較第二季減少 1 點。
存款規模突破 4 兆元與高活存比：第三季總存款年增 6.5% 突破 4 兆元大關，其中新台幣存款年增 3.7% 至 2.87 兆元，外幣存款大增 13.6% 達 1.2 兆元。憑藉企業金流與薪轉戶基礎，第三季台幣活存比穩步上升至 62.14%。
產業集中度分散：放款結構中製造業占 22.95%（電子資訊業達 5.66%），非製造業占 77.05%，產業分布多元分散。
房貸業務與風險控管：第三季新承作房貸金額為 320.7 億元，平均成數 64.94%；整體房貸餘額平均貸放成數低至 49%，平均房貸利率維持 2.32%。區域分布以北北基及桃園合計占比高達 63.1%，擔保品流動性與保值性優異。
手續費收入與營業費用率：前三季財管手收由去年同期 65.28 億元大增 30.8% 至 85.4 億元，占整體淨手收比重由 67.4% 突破七成至 71.5%；放款相關手收亦年增 6.6%。單看第三季淨手收為 39.45 億元，因第二季基期較高及金融市場波動加劇而季減 6.5%。前三季累積營業費用占比由去年同期的 43.01% 下降 0.75 個百分點至 42.26%。

資產品質與資本適足率：截至 9 月底整體逾放比穩守 0.16%，呆帳覆蓋率達 864.09%；其中大型企業維持零逾放、中小企業 0.19%、房貸 0.07%、個人放款 0.09%。海外業務前三季稅前獲利達 76.20 億元，占全行稅前獲利 27.46%，單季連三季成長創近期新高。第三季銀行資本適足率為 14.8%，第一類資本比率 12.69%，CET1 為 11.27%，均高於系統性重要銀行法定標準。
四、Q&A 問答重點整理
2027 年全球與台灣經濟景氣展望
Q：2026 年 GDP 整體成長相當不錯，現已接近年底，經營團隊對 2027 年全球及台灣的景氣看法為何？（綜合提問）

A： 全球經濟：2026 年雖受中東戰爭與能源價格上升干擾，但受惠 AI 高效能運算與雲端服務投資擴張，全球 GDP 預估成長 3.1%。2027 年能源衝擊將逐步消化，AI 資本支出續撐復甦，全球 GDP 預估值維持 3.4% 不變。 台灣前景：受惠 AI 及半導體供應鏈需求強勁帶動出口與民間投資，2026 年台灣 GDP 有望突破 12%。2027 年在極高基期墊高下增幅自然趨緩，但仍延續正增長趨勢，公司內部預估（In-house view）2027 年台灣經濟成長率約落在 6% 左右。
2027 年放款業務成長預估
Q：2026 年第三季簡報顯示放款仍有高達 13% 左右的年成長，符合今年雙位數成長的 guidance，請問對 2027 年放款業務的看法與預估？（統一投顧 Tina）
A： 預估 2027 年一銀總放款成長率約為 5% 到 6%。 策略將以「擇優擴量、資本增效」為核心調整結構，明年重點著重在中小企業放款，預估成長率可達 10%；房屋貸款預估成長約 4.5%；外幣放款預估成長約 9%，將持續聚焦 AI 半導體重點業務、高收益海外放款案及台商赴美投資商機。
淨利差（NIM）與 FX Swap 收益展望
Q1：今年淨利差表現呈現稍微下滑現象，如何看待明年調整後淨利差（含 Swap）的水準？明年的 Swap 收益看法為何？（凱基證券 Eric、統一投顧 Tina）
Q2：明年 Swap 收益預估成長，但調整後 NIM 較今年預估略往下，是否代表原始 NIM 下滑及其原因？預估中是否已隱含美台利率政策調整？（統一投顧 Tina）
Q3：再次確認 2026 全年含 Swap 的調整後 NIM 預估值為何？（凱基證券 Eric）

A： 2026 全年預估：今年（預計至 12 月）加計 Swap 之後的調整後 NIM 預估來到 1%；FX Swap 前 10 月收益約 90 億元，2026 全年目標挑戰 105 億元。 2027 全年預估：2027 年含 Swap 的調整後 NIM 預估可達 1.02%；因美元升息帶動台美利差擴大，明年 Swap 收益目標挑戰 125 億至 127 億元（約 126 億元）。 利差變動與利率假設：去年 9 月 Fed 降息使外幣利差收窄，今年 9 月 Fed 重啟升息趨勢加上 AI 帶動資金需求、市場流動性趨緊及 LCR 管制，預期市場資金成本上揚將影響剩餘資金運用收益。預估中已納入利率政策假設，未來將透過提高外幣存放比、優化台外幣存放結構、強化高收益資產配置及靈活操作 Swap，帶動明年整體淨利收與 NIM 表現優於今年。
手續費收入與財富管理業務展望
Q1：簡報顯示第三季財富管理手收季減 6.5%，雖然今年整體手收強勁，但第三季較第二季下滑的原因為何？如何看待第四季與明年？（匿名提問）
Q2：展望 2027 年，對整體手續費收入及財富管理業務的成長動能預估為何？（延續提問）
A： 第三季季減原因與第四季展望：主因全球市場波動，保險與信託手收不如上半年亮麗，第四季預估維持與第三季相當的水準。 推展重點與 2027 目標：下半年與明年將持續聚焦高資產業務與亞洲資產管理中心（亞灣）業務，全力推廣 Lombard Lending（倫巴底貸款）、保費融資及家族辦公室業務。預估 2027 年整體手續費收入維持雙位數成長，其中財富管理手收以成長 15% 為目標。
中小企業資產品質、信用成本與營業費用率展望
Q1：簡報中顯示中小企業的逾放比（NPL）較第二季微幅上升，請問中小企業 NPL 是否有特別疑慮？上升原因為何？（高盛證券 Simon）
Q2：今年前三季信用成本維持不錯，請問今年全年淨信用成本與當初預估值是否調整？明年的淨信用成本預估為何？（延續提問）
Q3：明年的營業費用率（CI Ratio）預估為何？（統一投顧 Tina）

A： 中小企業 NPL：大型企業逾放比維持 0%，中小企業僅由 0.18% 微升至 0.19%（增加 0.01%），主因偶有零星個案產生，金額不大且無系統性風險；整體逾放比仍穩守 0.16%，資產品質相當良好。 淨信用成本：2026 年初預估全年淨信用成本為 18 個 bp，截至 9 月底實際數為 16 個 bp；預估 2027 年淨信用成本維持 18 個 bp。 營業費用率：與往年水準相當，預估 2027 年營業費用率（CI Ratio）約落在 42% 到 43% 左右。
股利配發政策
Q：過往對外溝通配發率約在六成左右，而配發 2025 年度股利時現金配發率高達 69%，請問 2026 年度（明年配發）的股利配發是否有可能達到此水準，或經營團隊的目標為何？（凱基證券 Eric）
A： 公司股利政策以發放現金股利為主，原則上現金股利配發率（Payout Ratio）仍以六成以上為基本目標。 實際配發水準需併同考量子公司股利上繳情形、明年業務發展計畫以及資本管理對業務成長的支援需求，待明年整體狀況衡量後再提案至董事會討論，會盡量回饋股東的長期支持。
paras_en: 1. Operating Highlights

2. The holding company posted record profit for the period: net profit after tax for the first three quarters of 2026 reached NT$26.225 billion, up 26.9% year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$1.82. The flagship subsidiary, First Bank, earned NT$23.2 billion (up 13%) – a new high; non‑bank subsidiaries together earned NT$4.0 billion, surpassing previous peaks and raising their share of total profit from under 9% to above 14%, making the profit structure more diversified and stable.

3. Core banking businesses grew at double‑digit rates: Net interest income rose 14.6% year‑over‑year, driven by steady loan expansion; a hot capital‑markets environment boosted wealth‑management fee income by 30.8%, lifting overall net fee income by 23.3% year‑over‑year.

4. Corporate financing demand remained strong: AI‑related industry investments and working‑capital needs pushed total loan balances up 12.9% year‑over‑year. Both foreign‑currency loans and large‑enterprise loans posted double‑digit growth; SME loans broke the NT$1 trillion mark (up 8%) and stayed market‑leading; mortgage loans also grew solidly at 5.8%.

5. Promotion of public‑sector fund merger: The board approved on Oct 22 a plan to merge public‑sector mutual funds, with First Financial Investment Trust becoming the surviving entity, creating a national‑level asset‑management platform that integrates distribution channels, products and research resources to deepen scale and competitive advantage.
6. 2. Financial Summary of the Holding Company and Subsidiary Performance

7. Financial metrics improved across the board: Total assets grew 9.5% in the first three quarters of 2026, and book value per share rose 9.4% to NT$21.5. Average return on equity (ROE) jumped from 10.01% a year ago to 11.61%, and average return on assets (ROA) increased from 0.57% to 0.67%. The group’s capital adequacy ratio stayed at a high 124.16%, and the dual‑leverage ratio was kept steady at 114.5%.

8. Consolidated earnings showed strong momentum: Consolidated net profit for the first three quarters rose 16.9% year‑over‑year to NT$62.6 billion; with credit costs and operating expenses well‑controlled, net profit after tax grew 26.9% to NT$26.2 billion, and other comprehensive income added up to a consolidated comprehensive profit of NT$38.9 billion.
9. After‑tax net profit of each subsidiary:
10. First Financial Securities: after‑tax net profit rose to NT$2.0 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 165.2%.
11. First Financial Life: benefiting from strong investment returns and a solid post‑IFRS 17 footing, after‑tax net profit jumped from NT$0.076 billion a year ago to NT$6.48 billion.
12. First Financial Investment Trust: profit grew 120.5% to NT$2.91 billion.
13. First Financial AMC and First Financial Venture Capital also delivered strong profit growth.

14. Annualised ROE now exceeds historical levels: the holding company’s cumulative net profit for the first three quarters is close to the full‑year 2025 figure, and the annualised ROE this year has stayed above 11% (higher than the 9.6%‑10.8% range of the past two years); First Bank’s Q3 annualised ROE reached 9.79%, also above the 9.55% a year ago and the full‑year 8.79% level.
15. 3. First Bank Business Performance

16. Pre‑tax profit structure: cumulative net profit for the first three quarters reached NT$54.57 billion, up 9.0% year‑over‑year. Although income from financial products slipped slightly, the two core profit drivers – net interest income (up 14.6% to NT$26.1 billion) and net fee income (up 23.3% to NT$11.9 billion) – fully offset the gap; loan‑loss provisions and related fee expenses were flat versus last year, while operating expenses rose modestly 7% in line with business growth.

17. Loan portfolio surpassed NT$3 trillion: as of end‑September, total loan balance grew from NT$2.7 trillion a year ago to NT$3.09 trillion, a 12.9% increase. Foreign‑currency loans rose 22.5%, large‑enterprise loans 17.2%, and SME loans grew 8% to NT$1.721 trillion, maintaining market‑leadership. Q3 alone saw loan additions of NT$147.2 billion (up 5% quarter‑over‑quarter), with all business lines posting positive quarterly growth.

18. Deposit ratio and net interest margin (NIM): the overall deposit ratio climbed from 70.34% a year ago to 74.46% in Q3 (NT$88.6% for TWD deposits, 46.4% for foreign‑currency deposits); the three‑quarter average NIM was 0.75% with a spread of 1.18%. In Q3, the TWD loan rate rose 1 percentage point to 2.37% while the deposit rate was 1.08%, widening the TWD spread to 1.29% (+1 ppt). Foreign‑currency loan and deposit rates each rose 10‑11 ppt quarter‑over‑quarter, pushing the foreign‑currency spread to 1.96% (+1 ppt). However, because the foreign‑currency deposit ratio stayed at 46.4% and money‑market funding was slightly tight, overall NIM fell by 1 ppt versus Q2.

19. Deposits broke the NT$4 trillion barrier with a high active‑deposit ratio: Q3 total deposits grew 6.5% year‑over‑year, surpassing NT$4 trillion. TWD deposits rose 3.7% to NT$2.87 trillion, while foreign‑currency deposits surged 13.6% to NT$1.2 trillion. Leveraging corporate cash flows and payroll‑transfer accounts, the TWD active‑deposit ratio rose steadily to 62.14% in Q3.

20. Industry concentration is diversified: within the loan book, manufacturing accounts for 22.95% (electronics & information 5.66%), while non‑manufacturing makes up 77.05%, indicating a broadly diversified sector mix.

21. Mortgage business and risk control: new mortgage originations in Q3 totalled NT$32.07 billion with an average loan‑to‑value (LTV) of 64.94%; the overall mortgage portfolio’s average LTV was low at 49% and the average mortgage rate held at 2.32%. Geographically, the North‑Taipei‑Keelung‑Taoyuan region accounted for 63.1% of the portfolio, offering strong collateral liquidity and value preservation.

22. Fee income and operating‑expense ratio: wealth‑management fee income rose 30.8% year‑over‑year to NT$8.54 billion, representing 71.5% of total net fee income (up from 67.4%). Loan‑related fee income also grew 6.6% year‑over‑year. Q3 net fee income was NT$3.945 billion, down 6.5% quarter‑over‑quarter due to a higher Q2 base and heightened market volatility. The three‑quarter operating‑expense ratio fell 0.75 percentage points to 42.26% from 43.01% a year ago.

23. Asset quality and capital adequacy: as of end‑September, the overall non‑performing loan (NPL) ratio held steady at 0.16% and the loan‑loss coverage ratio was 864.09%. Large enterprises maintained a 0% NPL rate, SMEs were at 0.19%, mortgages 0.07%, and personal loans 0.09%. Pre‑tax profit from overseas operations in the first three quarters reached NT$7.62 billion, accounting for 27.46% of total pre‑tax profit, marking a three‑quarter consecutive increase and a recent high. Q3 bank capital adequacy ratio was 14.8%, Tier‑1 capital ratio 12.69%, CET1 11.27%, all above the regulatory thresholds for systemically important banks.
24. 4. Q&A Highlights
25. 2027 Global and Taiwan Economic Outlook
26. Q: 2026 GDP growth was solid and the year is almost over. What is the management’s view on the 2027 global and Taiwan economic outlook? (Combined question)

27. A: Global economy – despite disruptions from the Middle‑East conflict and higher energy prices in 2026, AI‑driven high‑performance computing and cloud‑service investments lifted global GDP growth to an estimated 3.1%. In 2027, energy shocks are expected to ease, and AI capital spending will continue to support recovery, keeping global GDP growth forecast at 3.4%. Taiwan – strong AI and semiconductor‑supply‑chain demand is boosting exports and private investment, allowing Taiwan’s 2026 GDP to potentially exceed 12%. With a very high base, 2027 growth will naturally moderate but remain positive; the in‑house view projects Taiwan’s 2027 growth around 6%.
28. 2027 Loan‑Business Growth Forecast

29. Q: The Q3 2026 presentation showed loan growth of roughly 13% year‑over‑year, matching the double‑digit guidance for this year. What are your expectations and forecasts for loan growth in 2027? (Unified Investment Tina)

30. A: We project First Bank’s total loan growth in 2027 to be about 5%‑6%. The strategy will focus on “selective expansion and capital efficiency,” with an emphasis on SME loans, which are expected to grow around 10%; mortgage loans about 4.5%; and foreign‑currency loans roughly 9%. The bank will continue to target AI‑related semiconductor businesses, high‑yield overseas loan opportunities, and Taiwanese companies investing in the United States.
31. Net‑Interest‑Margin (NIM) and FX‑Swap Income Outlook

32. Q1: This year’s NIM showed a slight decline. How do you view the adjusted NIM (including swaps) level for next year? What is the outlook for swap income? (KGI Securities Eric, Unified Investment Tina)

33. Q2: Swap income is expected to grow next year, but the adjusted NIM appears lower than this year’s forecast. Does this indicate a drop in the underlying NIM and why? Does the forecast already embed US‑Taiwan rate‑policy adjustments? (Unified Investment Tina)
34. Q3: Please confirm the full‑year 2026 adjusted NIM (including swaps) forecast. (KGI Securities Eric)

35. A: 2026 full‑year forecast – after adding swaps, the adjusted NIM is expected to reach 1.0%; FX‑swap income for the first ten months is about NT$9 billion, with a 2026 target of NT$10.5 billion. 2027 full‑year forecast – adjusted NIM (including swaps) could reach 1.02%; a larger US‑rate spread will push swap income targets to NT$12.5‑12.7 billion (≈NT$12.6 billion). Rate‑movement assumptions: last September the Fed cut rates, narrowing foreign‑currency spreads; this September the Fed resumed hikes, and together with AI‑driven funding demand, tighter market liquidity and LCR constraints, funding costs are expected to rise, affecting residual‑funds returns. The forecast already incorporates these rate‑policy assumptions, and we will aim to improve next year’s overall net‑interest income and NIM by raising foreign‑currency deposit ratios, optimizing the TWD‑foreign‑currency deposit mix, strengthening high‑yield asset allocation, and flexibly managing swaps.
36. Fee‑Income and Wealth‑Management Business Outlook

37. Q1: The presentation shows Q3 wealth‑management fee income fell 6.5% quarter‑over‑quarter. Although overall fee income was strong this year, what caused the Q3 dip and what are the expectations for Q4 and next year? (Anonymous)
38. Q2: Looking ahead to 2027, what growth drivers do you anticipate for overall fee income and the wealth‑management business? (Follow‑up)

39. A: Reason for Q3 dip and Q4 outlook – the main cause was heightened global market volatility, which dampened insurance and trust fee income compared with the first half of the year. Q4 is expected to hold at a level similar to Q3. Growth focus and 2027 target – in the second half of this year and next year we will keep concentrating on high‑net‑worth clients and the Asian Asset Management Hub (Asia‑Bay) business, aggressively promoting Lombard lending, premium financing and family‑office services. We project overall fee income to maintain double‑digit growth in 2027, with wealth‑management fee income targeting a 15% increase.
40. SME Asset Quality, Credit Cost and Operating‑Expense Ratio Outlook
41. Q1: The presentation shows the SME NPL ratio rose slightly from Q2. Is there any particular concern about SME NPLs? What caused the increase? (Goldman Sachs Simon)
42. Q2: Credit cost was solid in the first three quarters. Will the full‑year net credit cost be adjusted from the original estimate? What is the net credit‑cost outlook for next year? (Follow‑up)
43. Q3: What is the forecast for next year’s operating‑expense ratio (CI Ratio)? (Unified Investment Tina)

44. A: SME NPLs – large enterprises remain at 0% NPL, while SME NPL rose marginally from 0.18% to 0.19% (a 0.01% increase) due to occasional isolated cases that are small and not systemic; the overall NPL ratio stays at 0.16%, indicating sound asset quality. Net credit cost – the original 2026 full‑year net credit‑cost estimate was 18 bps; as of end‑September the actual figure was 16 bps. The 2027 net credit‑cost is projected to stay at 18 bps. Operating‑expense ratio – expected to be in line with historical levels, around 42%‑43% for 2027.
45. Dividend Distribution Policy

46. Q: Historically the payout ratio has been around 60%, and the 2025 dividend payout ratio reached 69% cash. Is it possible to achieve a similar level for the 2026 dividend, or what is the management’s target? (KGI Securities Eric)

47. A: The company’s dividend policy focuses on cash dividends, with a baseline payout ratio target of at least 60%. The actual payout will also consider subsidiary dividend contributions, next year’s business plans, and capital‑management needs to support growth. The final proposal will be evaluated after the overall 2026 situation is assessed and then submitted to the board for discussion, aiming to reward shareholders’ long‑term support as much as possible.

items.title: 熱門股〉貿聯-KY獲利創高、展望正向 投信11月來大買力挺周漲29%
items.title_en: Hot Stock > Maolian-KY Posts Record Profit, Outlook Positive; Mutual Funds Ramp Up Buying in November Supporting 29% Weekly Gain
paras: 連接線大廠貿聯-KY(3665-TW)獲利創高、展望維持正向，雖然遭到外資連續多日調節，但投信積極承接，連12個交易日買超共1.08萬張，11月以來更僅有1日賣超，近1個月總計買超1.26萬張，也帶動貿聯股價本周跌深反彈，周漲29%。
貿聯第三季稅後純益42.93億元，季增44%、年增63.33%，每股純益21.83元，創單季歷史新高；累計前三季稅後純益95.49億元，年增52.41%，每股純益48.77元，創同期歷史新高，並超越去年全年。
展望2027年，執行長鄧劍華表示，雖然技術世代更替、客戶部署時程及產能瓶頸仍可能帶來波動，但看好高效能運算(HPC)、半導體設備(SPE)及集團整體產品組合的長期成長機會，將持續深化布局，投入下一世代銅纜、光纖解決方案，以及更精密的電力與連接傳輸產品。
鄧劍華指出，隨著客戶拓展新應用及新市場，貿聯將深化跨國及跨區域合作，整合全球專業知識與製造資源，提升承接大型專案的能力；在營運策略上，除追求規模成長，也將重視投資報酬及資本紀律，將技術實力與營運規模轉化為更高獲利、資本運用效率及穩定現金流。
paras_en: Maolian-KY (3665-TW), a major connector manufacturer, posted record earnings and maintained a positive outlook. Although foreign investors trimmed positions for several consecutive days, mutual funds stepped in aggressively, net buying 10,800 contracts over 12 trading days. Since November, they have recorded only one day of net selling, and over the past month they net bought 12,600 contracts, helping the stock rebound sharply after a deep dip, delivering a 29% gain for the week.

In the third quarter, Maolian reported after‑tax net profit of NT$4.293 billion, up 44% quarter‑over‑quarter and 63.33% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$21.83 – a historic quarterly high. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, after‑tax net profit reached NT$9.549 billion, a 52.41% increase year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$48.77, also a record for the same period and surpassing the full‑year result of the prior year.

Looking ahead to 2027, CEO Deng Jianhua said that while technology cycles, customer deployment schedules and capacity bottlenecks may still cause volatility, the company is optimistic about long‑term growth opportunities in high‑performance computing (HPC), semiconductor equipment (SPE) and the group’s overall product portfolio. Maolian will continue deepening its positioning, investing in next‑generation copper cables, fiber‑optic solutions, and more precise power and transmission products.

Deng added that as customers expand into new applications and markets, Maolian will deepen cross‑border and cross‑regional collaborations, integrating global expertise and manufacturing resources to boost its ability to handle large projects. Strategically, beyond pursuing scale growth, the firm will emphasize investment returns and capital discipline, converting technical strength and operational scale into higher profitability, more efficient capital use, and stable cash flow.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉王品成資金避風港 穩居觀光餐旅股王
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Wang Pin Becomes a Capital Safe Haven, Firmly the King of Tourism and Restaurant Stocks
paras: 連鎖餐飲集團王品(2727-TW)宣布今年尾牙將席開千桌，舉辦成演唱會級的萬人盛會，在觀光餐旅業中史無前例，而明年又將開出超過千個職缺，以因應展店所需人力，法人看好其今明年獲利動能；王品是目前股價唯一穩在200元上的觀光餐旅業者，過去一個月來股價僅回檔修正6%，成為資金避風港。
王品12月預計開10家店，而明年展店將聚焦火鍋品類，預計招募超過1200人，並提供快速升遷培訓計畫，若晉升為店長有機會年薪上看200萬元。
為持續吸引人才加入，王品今年席開近千桌，並邀請新生代創作歌手陳華、高爾宣、人氣樂團告五人等知名藝人演出，並將發出近千萬摸彩獎金，強打服務業的好福利。
法人指出，王品維持在台灣市場的展店步伐，中國事業群也透過品牌重塑與穩健拓點，逐步改善營運中；同時，王品以超過600萬名會員的瘋美食生態圈，有效掌握餐飲消費樣貌，築起高獲利護城河，值得樂觀看待今明兩年獲利結構穩健。
paras_en: Chain restaurant group Wang Pin (2727-TW) announced this year's year‑end banquet will seat a thousand tables, hosting a concert‑level event for ten thousand people—unprecedented in the tourism and hospitality industry. Next year it will create over a thousand job openings to meet staffing needs for new stores. Institutional investors are optimistic about its profit momentum this year and next. Wang Pin is currently the only tourism‑hospitality stock with its price steady above NT$200; over the past month the share price has only corrected 6%, making it a capital safe haven.

Wang Pin plans to open 10 stores in December, and next year's expansion will focus on hot‑pot concepts, expecting to recruit more than 1,200 people and offer fast‑track promotion training. Those promoted to store manager could earn up to NT$2 million annual salary.

To keep attracting talent, Wang Pin will host nearly a thousand banquet tables this year and invite new‑generation singer‑songwriters Chen Hua, Gao Erxuan, and popular band “告五人” among other well‑known artists to perform, and will award nearly NT$10 million in raffle prizes, emphasizing strong benefits for the service industry.

Institutional investors note that Wang Pin maintains its store‑opening pace in Taiwan, while its China business unit improves operations through brand revitalization and steady expansion. Moreover, with over 6 million members in its “Crazy Food” ecosystem, Wang Pin effectively captures dining consumption patterns, building a high‑profit moat, and is viewed optimistically for a solid profit structure over the next two years.

items.title: 黃仁勳回鍋輝達CEO台股噴漲3310點創紀錄、富邦006208分割投票、融資維持率120%上路 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Returns as Nvidia CEO, Taiwan Stocks Surge 3,310 Points to Record, Fubon 006208 Split Vote, Margin Maintenance Ratio Set at 120% – Weekly Highlights
paras: 黃仁勳周一(23日)宣布回鍋輝達CEO，激勵台股周三(24日)大漲3310點創史上最大漲點；富邦006208啟動分割投票，於周五(27日)起開放電子投票；融資維持率自24日起由130%調降至120%，何時調回原水準，金管會表示，目前沒有預設時程，以下為本周大事回顧：

黃仁勳回鍋激勵大漲3310點創歷史最大漲點 收40122點站回年線 

黃仁勳回鍋輝達CEO，激勵美股、日韓股市大漲，台指期延續夜盤漲勢，今(24)日開盤後漲停鎖住表態，加權指數也跳空開高直接站回4萬點及年線之上，收盤上漲3310.46點，創歷史最大漲點，漲幅近9%，收40122.35點，不過，成交金額僅4194億元，為今年以來最低。

富邦006208分割投票27日開跑 估1拆7、入手一張只要3萬元 

富邦投信周四(26日)舉辦富邦台50 ETF(006208-TW)分割投票啟動記者會，宣布自11月27日至12月15日開放電子投票，並於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，期盼透過分割降低投資門檻，提升資金配置彈性。006208於2012年6月22日成立，初次發行價格為30元，本次分割倍數暫估為1拆7。若以每單位淨值210元為例，分割後淨值將調整為30元，一張變七張，按淨值估算的整張交易金額由21萬元降至3萬元。

融資維持率120%上路！當年亞洲金融風暴一降就是17年 金管會：何時調回無時間表 

金管會周二(24日)舉行例行記者會，台股近期震盪加劇，主管機關接連出手穩定市場信心，其中融資維持率自24日起由130%調降至120%，上一次放寬可追溯至1998年亞洲金融風暴期間，當時歷經約17年，直到2015年才恢復130%。至於這次何時調回原水準，證期局副局長黃仲豪表示，目前沒有預設時程，將視整體市場狀況、整戶擔保維持率及追繳戶數恢復情況來評估。

〈工業生產指數〉AI浪潮捲動32紅！10月工業生產指數衝破151大關年增近3成 

經濟部周二(24日)公布10 月工業生產統計連32紅，受惠於人工智慧與高效能運算需求大爆發，單月工業生產指數攀升至 151.30，月增 7.3%，年增率更衝上 29.8%。其中製造業表現最為亮眼，生產指數達 154.61，年增 31.63%，帶動累計前 10 月工業生產較上年同期成長 21.52%。

印度子公司傳欠款遭供應商聲請破產 鴻海：雙方履約情形存在歧見 

鴻海(2317-TW)印度子公司傳與供應商爆發款項爭議，甚至遭聲請破產。對此，鴻海發出聲明指出，本案主要涉及供應商提供的服務未符合雙方契約約定及品質要求，雙方目前已進入司法程序。

〈兆豐金法說〉輝達狂飆36%帶旺台股！企金與海外放款雙位數成長 明年股利配發率站穩7成 

輝達（NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳閃電回鍋激勵輝達股價周一 (23日) 一度瘋漲逾 36%，帶動台股周二(24日)強勢反攻大漲近 9%。兆豐金控 (2886-TW) 今舉行 2026 年第三季線上法說會，透露受惠 AI 需求暢旺與半導體擴張，兆豐銀行前三季企金與海外放款均呈雙位數成長，推升集團獲利創同期新高，股利配發率亦穩守 7 成。
paras_en: Jensen Huang announced on Monday (the 23rd) that he is returning as Nvidia CEO, spurring a massive rally in Taiwan stocks on Wednesday (the 24th) that lifted the market by 3,310 points, a historic high; Fubon 006208 launched a split‑vote, with electronic voting opening on Friday (the 27th); the margin maintenance ratio was lowered from 130% to 120% starting on the 24th, and the Financial Supervisory Commission said there is no set timetable for restoring it. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

Jensen Huang’s comeback drove a record‑setting rise of 3,310 points, pushing the index back above the 40,000‑point and yearly trend line. The index opened higher after a limit‑up lock‑in, jumped to 40,122.35 points at close – up 3310.46 points, nearly 9% – marking the biggest single‑day gain ever, though turnover was only NT$419.4 billion, the lowest since the start of the year.

Fubon Asset Management held a press conference on Thursday (the 26th) to launch the split‑vote for its Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW). Electronic voting will be available from Nov 27 to Dec 15, with a written beneficiary meeting on Dec 18. The split, tentatively 1‑for‑7, aims to lower the investment threshold and increase allocation flexibility. The ETF, launched on June 22 2012 at NT$30 per unit, has a net asset value of NT$210; after the split each unit would be NT$30, turning one share into seven, reducing the full‑share transaction amount from NT$210,000 to NT$30,000.

The Financial Supervisory Commission held its regular press briefing on Tuesday (the 24th) amid heightened market volatility. To stabilize confidence, it lowered the margin maintenance ratio from 130% to 120% starting that day. The last relaxation dates back to the 1998 Asian financial crisis, lasting about 17 years until 2015 when the ratio returned to 130%. As for when it will be raised again, Securities and Futures Bureau Deputy Director Huang Zhong‑hao said there is no preset schedule; the decision will depend on overall market conditions, household margin ratios, and the recovery of margin calls.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs released October industrial production data on Tuesday (the 24th), showing a 32‑month streak of gains. Fueled by a surge in AI and high‑performance computing demand, the index rose to 151.30, up 7.3% month‑on‑month and 29.8% year‑on‑year. Manufacturing led the charge with an index of 154.61, a 31.63% annual increase, pushing cumulative production for the first ten months up 21.52% versus the same period last year.

Foxconn’s (2317‑TW) Indian subsidiary is reported to be in a payment dispute with a supplier, which has even filed for bankruptcy. Foxconn issued a statement saying the dispute centers on the supplier’s services not meeting contractual and quality standards, and that the parties are now in judicial proceedings.

In Mega Financial Holding’s (2886‑TW) Q3 2026 online earnings call, the company highlighted that Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) founder Jensen Huang’s rapid return sent Nvidia’s stock soaring over 36% on Monday (the 23rd), which in turn drove Taiwan stocks up nearly 9% on Tuesday (the 24th). Benefiting from strong AI demand and semiconductor expansion, Mega Bank’s corporate and overseas loan portfolios grew double‑digit in the first three quarters, boosting group profit to a new peak and keeping the dividend payout ratio steady at 70%.

items.title: 〈台新新光金法說〉AI重點筆記2026/11/27
paras:
一、 2026 年前三季財務與營運詳情

財務表現：
獲利與規模：台新新光金(2887-TW)2026 年前三季稅後純益達 641.69 億元，年增 183.5%，每股稅後純益（EPS）2.47 元，年化股東權益報酬率（ROE）14.92%，每股淨值26.17 元。截至 9 月底總資產規模達 9.35 兆元。
子公司獲利： 銀行端合計稅後純益 268.86 億元、年增 54%（台新銀 193.4 億元、年增 25.1%；新光銀 75.46 億元、年增 86.7%）；新光人壽稅後純益 322.15 億元；台新證券受惠股市交投熱絡，稅後純益達 93.16 億元、年增 234.4%。
合併進度與子公司營運：
雙銀整併： 子公司整併邁入最後階段，台新銀行與新光銀行預計於 2027 年 1 月 1 日正式合併，並以台新銀行為存續主體，各項整併工作正依內部規劃穩健推進，力求發揮綜效、創造長期股東價值。

銀行業務： 台新銀前三季利息淨收益 304.18 億元（年增 24.3%）、手續費淨收益 161.87 億元（年增 25.1%），總放款 2 兆 594 億元（年增 8.6%）。第 3 季 NIM 為 1.38%（季減 4 bps），隨個人戶存款比重拉升，第 4 季估回升至接近第 2 季水準，全年維持較去年提升 5～8 bps 目標；9 月底 CET1 為 10.64%，LCR 近期維持在 120% 上下。新光銀調整 Swap 收入後第 3 季 NIM 為 1.28%。

壽險業務： 新光人壽前三季初年度保費（FYP）1,037 億元（年增 30%），外幣保單占 FYP 68.9%；9 月底淨值資產比達 10%，CSM 餘額 2,986 億元（新契約 CSM 493 億元，達成率約 70%）。9 月底股票未實現利益近 600 億元，11 月雖震盪但維持正數，且採 6 個月均價與過渡措施，不影響新一代清償能力（TIS）。外幣新錢投報率近 6%，台幣債券 ETF 部位近 1,500 億元（占資產約 5%），第 3 季避險比率約 47% 接近內部 40%～50% 目標上緣。
股利政策與轉投資：
股利方向： 明年股利以「現金」為主，保留股票股利彈性，考量獲利表現、同業殖利率競爭力與長期穩定成長三大原則；因主管機關尚未公布壽險上繳規範，目前試算暂不計入壽險子公司上繳。
轉投資持股： 揭露目前持有彰化銀行 3 億股、鑽石生技 5,690 萬股。

【台新新光金法說會完整問答(Q&A)】

Q1：關於明年股利政策與壽險子公司上繳股利規範？ 回答：具體配息數字需待年底結帳後評估並提報董事會決定，方向上以現金股利為主並保留股票股利彈性，考量獲利狀況、同業水準與殖利率競爭力、長期穩定成長三大原則。壽險上繳因主管機關尚未公布規範，現階段先以其他子公司上繳試算、不計入壽險上繳；留意 11 月 23 日行政院會議中工商協進會與壽險公會建請平衡資本健全與配息需求，金管會過去在避險成本與會計新制接軌提供實質協助，將靜待主管機關決議並全力配合。
Q2：明年是否會配發股票股利？ 回答：以現金股利為主，但會保留股票股利彈性，屆時將視現金殖利率與總殖利率競爭力做最後決定。

Q3：台新銀第 3 季 NIM 變化原因、第 4 季與全年展望，以及台美升息 1 碼的影響？ 回答：台新銀第 3 季 NIM 由第 2 季 1.42% 降至 1.38%（減 4 bps），主因同業存款專案競爭及美國升息影響外幣配置；隨個人戶存款比重增加，第 4 季 NIM 估回升至接近第 2 季水準，全年維持較去年提升 5～8 bps 目標（明年預算尚在編製）。若台灣升息 1 碼，銀行整體 NIM 正向增加 0.3 bps；若美國升息 1 碼，則負向影響 0.4 bps。
Q4：台新銀 9 月底 CET1 與新光銀調整 Swap 收入後的第 3 季 NIM 為何？ 回答：台新銀 9 月底 CET1 為 10.64%；新光銀調整相關收入後，第 3 季 NIM 為 1.28%。
Q5：第 3 季台新銀行 NPL 較高的原因，以及森崴、富威案提存進度與全年獲利展望？ 回答：第 3 季 NPL 比率略高，主因一筆大陸 100% 不動產擔保個案考量當地房市景氣而保守先行提存；森崴與富威案方面，台新銀已大部分提存，新光銀將於第 4 季提存，均已納入年度預估，年底雙銀獲利仍維持兩位數成長。
Q6：台新銀資金是否緊俏及 LCR 狀況？ 回答：今年受惠企業擴充、海外布局與中小企業放款成長，市場資金較緊，台新銀 8、9 月確實與同業一樣都相對較緊，但近期 LCR 維持在 120% 上下，資金緊俏度已趨緩。
Q7：財富管理業務表現與美國選後 AI 趨勢對放款策略的影響？ 回答：近期金融市場動盪使投資人轉趨保守，年底 12 月財管業務也較易放緩，但影響不大，今年財管手收成長仍在兩位數以上。AI 方面，今年企業資本支出推升放款成長顯著，預期 2027 年非陸系資料中心建置將按計畫推進，較大政策變數落在 2028 年各州新建資料中心新政策協商階段。
Q8：利率變動對淨值資產比的影響，以及第 3 季與前 9 月 FVOCI 股權變動情形？ 回答：利差收窄有利淨值比；假設台幣升 30 點、美元升 100 點，淨值資產比可上升 0.6%。第 3 季 FVOCI 股權部位因適時調節實現獲利而減少約 38 億元，但 1～9 月累計在 OCI 權益工具對淨值貢獻達 1,112 億元。

Q9：新壽台幣計價債券 ETF 部位、股市波動下未實現利益與 TIS 影響，以及外幣新錢投報率與避險比率？ 回答：台幣債券 ETF 部位近 1,500 億元（占資產約 5%），距離法定上限仍有空間；9 月底股票未實現利益近 600 億元，11 月雖震盪仍為正數，且採 6 個月均價與過渡措施，不影響 TIS。近期外幣新錢投報率近 6%，有助提升經常性收益；第 3 季避險比率約 47%，接近內部 40%～50% 目標上緣，未來具較大調降空間，將視匯率機動滾動調整。

Q10：新壽 CSM 是否有精算假設減損、CSM 其他變動 28 億元組成，以及新契約 CSM 全年達標信心與 9 月淨值比？ 回答：損益中預期數與實際數接近且維持正數，精算假設穩健無減損；CSM 其他變動 28 億元包含利息成本 +46 億元、估計變動 -30 億元（保單狀態與投資型帳戶價值變動）及匯率 +12 億元（美元微幅升值）。截至 9 月底新契約 CSM 達成率約 70% 符合預期，第 4 季傳統旺季有信心達標；9 月底淨值比已達 10%，未來預測則依主管機關要求以會計師查核數字為準。
Q11：彰銀與鑽石生技持股狀況為何？ 回答：目前持有彰化銀行 3 億股、鑽石生技 5,690 萬股。

items.title: OpenAI反訴蘋果指共同供應商受壓、未公開硬體資料遭取得
items.title_en: OpenAI Countersues Apple Over Pressured Joint Suppliers and Acquisition of Unpublished Hardware Data
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ OpenAI與旗下硬體公司io Products於27日向美國加州北區聯邦法院提出反訴，指控蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)不當取得尚未公開的硬體設計與製造資料，並對雙方共用的供應商施壓。這是蘋果7月提告後，同一案件首次由OpenAI正式提出反訴。
OpenAI在反訴文件中指出，部分專業製程只有一至兩家供應商符合資格。OpenAI主張，一家表面處理業者因蘋果反對雙方產品在同一區域或同一時段加工，改將OpenAI的工件移到夜班，增加作業成本；另有一家製造商據稱退出原定合作，迫使OpenAI重新安排生產。公開文件未點名這兩家廠商。
OpenAI另指，一名後來重返蘋果的前員工，在離職前將未公開裝置的設計圖及製造檢測資料傳至個人帳號。蘋果7月起訴時則指控，兩名前蘋果員工將機密資料帶往OpenAI，供其開發消費性硬體。OpenAI否認蘋果的指控；雙方主張仍待法院審理。

paras_en: On November 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) — OpenAI and its hardware subsidiary io Products filed a countersuit in the U.S. Northern District of California on the 27th, accusing Apple (AAPL-US) of improperly obtaining unpublished hardware design and manufacturing information and pressuring suppliers shared by both parties. This is the first formal countersuit by OpenAI in the same case after Apple’s July filing.

The countersuit states that only one or two suppliers are qualified for certain specialized processes. OpenAI alleges that a surface‑treatment vendor, opposed by Apple to processing both companies’ products in the same area or time slot, shifted OpenAI’s work to night shifts, raising operational costs; another manufacturer allegedly withdrew from a planned partnership, forcing OpenAI to rearrange production. The filing does not name the two firms.

OpenAI also claims that a former Apple employee who later returned to Apple transferred unpublished device schematics and manufacturing test data to a personal account before leaving. Apple’s July lawsuit alleged that two former Apple staff members took confidential data to OpenAI for developing consumer hardware. OpenAI denies Apple’s allegations; the claims await court adjudication.

items.title: Google比利時資料中心遭勒令停工每小時600立方公尺取水計畫卡關
items.title_en: Google Belgium Data Center Ordered to Halt Construction, 600 Cubic Meters per Hour Water Intake Plan Stalled
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 比利時瓦隆地區26日勒令Google暫停一座資料中心施工。當地官員表示，稽查人員到場時，約3公頃的建物主體已接近完工，但工程採用的變更方案未取得許可。
Google原獲准興建三座採氣冷的資料中心，後來申請把其中兩座合併，並改從附近的桑布爾河取水冷卻。依瓦隆議會文件，變更方案擬每小時取水600立方公尺，排回河道的水量不到四分之一。瓦隆官員今年8月駁回申請，理由是難以保證在20年許可期間內，即使遇上高溫與乾旱仍有足夠水量。
原有的三座氣冷資料中心許可仍然有效，其中一座截至10月已建成。Google旗下Crystal Computing已向比利時國務院聲請暫停執行並撤銷駁回決定，暫停執行案預定2027年1月7日開庭。

paras_en: On November 26, officials in Belgium's Walloon region ordered Google to suspend construction of a data center. The local authorities said that when inspectors arrived, the main building covering about 3 hectares was nearly completed, but the revised plan for the project had not been approved.

Google was originally granted permission to build three air‑cooled data centers, but later applied to merge two of them and switch to drawing cooling water from the nearby Sambre River. According to Walloon Parliament documents, the revised plan called for taking 600 cubic meters of water per hour, with less than a quarter of that volume being returned to the river. Walloon officials rejected the application in August, citing the inability to guarantee sufficient water supply over the 20‑year permit period, even during heatwaves and droughts.

The permits for the original three air‑cooled data centers remain valid, and one of them was completed by October. Google’s subsidiary Crystal Computing has petitioned the Belgian Council of Ministers to suspend enforcement and overturn the rejection, with a hearing on the suspension scheduled for January 7, 2027.

items.title: OpenAI反擊蘋果！控施壓供應商、限制員工跳槽  阻撓進軍AI硬體市場
items.title_en: OpenAI Strikes Back at Apple! Pressuring Suppliers and Restricting Employee Moves to Hinder AI Hardware Push
paras: OpenAI與蘋果(AAPL-US) 之間的商業機密訴訟再度升級。OpenAI最新提出反訴，指控蘋果利用對供應商的影響力，施壓業者不得與OpenAI合作，還透過限制性聘僱協議阻止工程師跳槽，妨礙OpenAI延攬人才，試圖阻止這家人工智慧（AI）公司進軍硬體市場。
根據《彭博》報導，OpenAI周五（27日）向美國加州聖荷西聯邦法院提出反訴，除指控蘋果不公平限制供應商與人才流動，也反控蘋果竊取OpenAI的商業機密，使原本由蘋果提起的訴訟，演變成雙方針對智慧財產權的法律攻防。
這場訴訟正值OpenAI準備跨足硬體市場之際。OpenAI正與蘋果前設計主管艾夫（Jony Ive）合作開發一系列硬體產品，首款產品預計是一款甜甜圈造型的智慧音箱。
OpenAI在反訴文件中指出，蘋果面對OpenAI可能進軍硬體市場，採取不當手段向供應商施壓，要求業者不要與OpenAI合作，同時利用範圍過於廣泛的聘僱限制，阻礙OpenAI取得優秀工程人才。OpenAI認為，蘋果不能利用對供應商及工程師的影響力，排除市場上的競爭者。
蘋果今年7月已對OpenAI及該公司硬體主管Tang Tan提起訴訟，指控OpenAI透過招募蘋果員工及延攬離職員工，策劃竊取商業機密。雙方過去曾合作，將ChatGPT整合至iPhone、iPad及Mac軟體，但近來合作關係逐漸降溫。
蘋果當時指控，OpenAI員工曾利用一台遭竊的蘋果公司筆電存取內部資料，並利用一項罕見、先前未被發現的身分驗證漏洞，進入蘋果內部共享網路。蘋果還稱，OpenAI曾要求仍在蘋果任職的求職者，在面試時帶來蘋果產品的「實際零件」。
對於OpenAI提出的反訴，蘋果反駁稱，這只是試圖轉移外界對原訴訟焦點的注意力，並強調法院已要求OpenAI停止使用蘋果機密資訊。
蘋果在聲明中表示，案件核心在於OpenAI員工蓄意竊取、訪問及使用蘋果尚未發布的技術、流程與產品機密，而非意外保留蘋果資訊。
OpenAI則進一步指控，蘋果要求產業供應商揭露與OpenAI合作的專案內容，以及具有蘋果工作經驗的員工姓名、工作地點與職務安排。OpenAI稱，蘋果隨後會設法阻止曾參與OpenAI專案的員工繼續為蘋果工作，變相讓供應商不敢派遣人力支援OpenAI。
反訴文件還指出，一家提供專業表面加工服務的供應商，為避免與蘋果的工作時段重疊，將OpenAI產品的製造作業改至夜班，導致OpenAI成本增加。OpenAI認為，供應商是受到蘋果施壓才做出這項調整。
OpenAI表示，部分供應商擔心失去蘋果訂單，因此刻意調整與OpenAI的會議時間，避免讓蘋果察覺合作關係；另有供應商告訴OpenAI，必須謹慎分配員工、產能及管理資源。
除了供應鏈問題，OpenAI也將矛頭指向蘋果的員工聘僱協議，質疑相關條款限制人才流動。OpenAI特別挑戰蘋果禁止離職員工在一年內招攬或招聘現職員工的規定。
OpenAI認為，蘋果要求員工簽署的智慧財產權協議（IPA），對公司機密資訊的定義過於寬泛，幾乎涵蓋員工在職期間接觸到的所有非公開資訊，即使相關內容並不構成商業機密，也受到限制。OpenAI主張，這些條款不合理地限制離職員工運用自身專業技能，還讓他們面臨遭蘋果提告的風險。
另一方面，OpenAI也在反訴中提出另一項商業機密爭議，指控一名前蘋果員工離職加入OpenAI，之後又返回蘋果任職期間，曾將超過100份高度機密文件傳送至個人帳戶。這些文件據稱涉及至少一款尚未發布的OpenAI裝置，內容包括未公開硬體圖片、工程與製造資料，以及供應商資訊。
蘋果則表示，公司設有相關政策，禁止員工使用前雇主的機密資料，且內部調查並未發現證據支持OpenAI的指控。
OpenAI否認蘋果提出的竊密指控，並已要求法官駁回蘋果的訴訟。今年10月，法官表示可能發布命令，要求OpenAI停止使用蘋果聲稱遭竊的商業機密後，OpenAI已主動同意不再使用相關資料。
蘋果原先提起的訴訟還點名一名前iPhone工程師 Chang Liu。他今年1月加入OpenAI，蘋果指控他在開發OpenAI硬體產品期間，利用發現的身分驗證漏洞，在數周內存取蘋果機密硬體文件。

paras_en: OpenAI and Apple (AAPL-US) have escalated their trade‑secret lawsuit. OpenAI has filed a counter‑claim accusing Apple of using its influence over suppliers to pressure them not to work with OpenAI, and of employing restrictive hiring agreements to block engineers from moving, thereby hampering OpenAI’s talent recruitment and trying to stop the AI company from entering the hardware market.

According to Bloomberg, OpenAI filed the counter‑claim on Friday (the 27th) in the U.S. District Court in San Jose, California, alleging that Apple unfairly limits supplier and talent mobility and also accusing Apple of stealing OpenAI’s trade secrets, turning the original Apple‑filed suit into a two‑sided intellectual‑property battle.

The lawsuit comes as OpenAI prepares to move into hardware. The company is working with former Apple design chief Jony Ive to develop a line of hardware products, with the first expected to be a donut‑shaped smart speaker.

In the counter‑claim, OpenAI says Apple, fearing OpenAI’s entry into hardware, has improperly pressured suppliers to refuse cooperation and has used overly broad employment restrictions to block OpenAI from hiring top engineers. OpenAI argues Apple cannot use its sway over suppliers and engineers to eliminate competition.

Apple sued OpenAI and its hardware head Tang Tan in July, alleging OpenAI recruited Apple staff and poached former employees to steal trade secrets. The two firms previously collaborated to integrate ChatGPT into iPhone, iPad and Mac software, but the partnership has cooled recently.

Apple alleged that an OpenAI employee accessed internal data using a stolen Apple laptop and exploited a rare, previously unknown authentication vulnerability to enter Apple’s internal network. Apple also said OpenAI asked job candidates still employed at Apple to bring actual Apple components to interviews.
Apple rebuffed OpenAI’s counter‑claim, saying it is an attempt to distract from the original case and noting the court has ordered OpenAI to stop using Apple’s confidential information.

In its statement, Apple said the core issue is that OpenAI employees deliberately stole, accessed and used Apple’s unreleased technology, processes and product secrets, not that they inadvertently retained Apple information.

OpenAI further alleges Apple demanded that industry suppliers disclose the details of any projects they were working on with OpenAI, as well as the names, locations and roles of employees with Apple experience. OpenAI says Apple then tried to prevent those employees from continuing to work for Apple, effectively deterring suppliers from supporting OpenAI.

The counter‑claim notes that a supplier providing specialized surface‑finishing services shifted OpenAI production to night shifts to avoid overlapping with Apple work, raising OpenAI’s costs. OpenAI says the supplier made the change only because of Apple’s pressure.

OpenAI says some suppliers, fearing loss of Apple orders, deliberately altered meeting times with OpenAI to keep the partnership hidden from Apple, while other suppliers told OpenAI they must carefully allocate staff, capacity and management resources.

Beyond supply‑chain issues, OpenAI also targets Apple’s employee agreements, questioning clauses that restrict talent mobility. OpenAI specifically challenges Apple’s rule that former employees may not solicit or hire current staff for one year after leaving.

OpenAI argues Apple’s Intellectual Property Agreement (IPA) defines confidential information so broadly that it covers virtually all non‑public information an employee encounters, even when that information does not constitute a trade secret, and that the clauses unreasonably limit former employees’ use of their skills and expose them to litigation risk from Apple.

In another trade‑secret dispute raised in the counter‑claim, OpenAI alleges a former Apple employee who left for OpenAI and later returned to Apple transmitted more than 100 highly confidential documents to a personal account. The files allegedly relate to at least one unreleased OpenAI device and include unpublished hardware images, engineering and manufacturing data, and supplier information.
Apple says it has policies prohibiting employees from using former employers’ confidential data and that its internal investigation found no evidence supporting OpenAI’s allegations.

OpenAI denies Apple’s theft accusations and has asked the judge to dismiss Apple’s suit. In October, the judge indicated a possible order requiring OpenAI to stop using the allegedly stolen Apple trade secrets, and OpenAI voluntarily agreed to cease using the material.

Apple’s original suit also singled out former iPhone engineer Chang Liu, who joined OpenAI in January. Apple alleges that while developing OpenAI hardware, Liu used a discovered authentication vulnerability to access Apple’s confidential hardware documents over several weeks.

items.title: 《彭博》輝達高階晶片現蹤上海！黃樂關係企業涉入、Blackwell設備成銀行抵押品
items.title_en: Bloomberg Reports Nvidia's High-End Chips Appearing in Shanghai! Huang Le-Related Enterprises Involved, Blackwell Equipment Used as Bank Collateral
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 最先進的Blackwell系列晶片疑似流入中國，再度引發外界對高階人工智慧（AI）晶片走私問題的關注。根據《彭博》周五報導，輝達最強大的Blackwell系列處理器，已出現在上海一座與黃樂（Alice Huang）有關聯的資料中心內。黃樂是一名常駐新加坡的商人，也是輝達晶片走私爭議的核心人物。
根據報導，提交給中國監管機構的文件顯示，兩家中國企業已在上海大型資料中心「長三角計畫」（Yangtze River Delta Project）部署搭載Blackwell晶片的硬體。
上海碩曜科技（Shanghai Shuoyao）以一套GB300 NVL72伺服器機櫃作為抵押品，向上海創新銀行取得人民幣9,600萬元（約1,400萬美元）貸款。
另一家企業上海科棧（Shanghai Kezhan）則在申請人民幣9,000萬元貸款的相關文件中，揭露其在同一地點設有一台GB200伺服器。提供這筆貸款的融資租賃公司由上海一家地方政府機構全資持有。
Blackwell系列晶片一直受到美國出口管制，未經美國政府許可不得出口至中國。美國總統川普也曾表明，不希望這類高階晶片流入中國。
輝達執行長黃仁勳過去則曾表示，相關設備體積龐大，難以走私，並指出標準規格的GB300 NVL72伺服器機櫃重量超過1,500公斤，高度約2公尺。
《彭博》將文件所載的產品序號輸入公開保固資料庫後，確認這套GB300機櫃由台灣技嘉(2376-TW) 製造。技嘉負責將輝達晶片組裝成伺服器及機櫃。
上海碩耀本月證實，該公司是Megaspeed的服務供應商，並將雙方關係描述為「僅限於一般商業合作」。
Megaspeed由黃樂於2023年創立，本月遭川普政府列入美國貿易黑名單。美國政府指出，該公司涉及晶片轉運的風險重大。Megaspeed則否認有任何不法行為。
黃樂與多家投資長三角資料中心計畫的企業有所關聯。知情人士透露，該資料中心董事長康偉（Kang Wei）有時被介紹為黃樂的丈夫。
上海科棧有83.3%的股權由日本NeXPower持有，該公司總部位於東京。中國財經媒體曾報導，NeXPower由黃樂控制。其餘16.7%股權則由中國遊戲公司第七大道(00797-HK)旗下子公司持有，而第七大道正是Megaspeed最初的母公司。
根據Big Trade Data的紀錄，上海科棧於2025年5月接收一批價值1,100萬美元的貨物，從馬來西亞空運至上海浦東國際機場。
海關文件將這批貨物描述為「儲存機箱」，但其申報的商品編碼847150實則代表「運算伺服器」，且每台單價高達26萬4,108美元，落在搭載輝達Hopper系列晶片伺服器的價格範圍內。
監管文件還顯示，上海創新銀行曾另外向上海龍捷（Shanghai Longjie）提供人民幣2億元貸款。上海龍捷與上海碩曜隸屬同一母公司，並以搭載受到出口限制的輝達Hopper世代晶片的設備作為貸款抵押品。
這些硬體由美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 及戴爾科技(DELL-US) 製造。目前尚不清楚相關設備運往中國時，是否取得美國政府許可。

paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US)’s most advanced Blackwell series chips appear to have entered China, reigniting concerns over the smuggling of high‑end artificial intelligence (AI) chips. According to Bloomberg’s Friday report, Nvidia’s flagship Blackwell processors have surfaced in a data centre in Shanghai linked to Alice Huang, a Singapore‑based businessman who is a central figure in the Nvidia chip smuggling controversy.

The report shows that documents filed with Chinese regulators indicate that two Chinese companies have deployed hardware equipped with Blackwell chips in the Shanghai data centre known as the Yangtze River Delta Project.
Shanghai Shuoyao used a GB300 NVL72 server rack as collateral to obtain a loan of 96 million yuan (about 14 million U.S. dollars) from Shanghai Innovation Bank.

Another company, Shanghai Kezhan, disclosed in its loan application documents for 90 million yuan that it has a GB200 server at the same site; the financing lease company providing the loan is wholly owned by a local government entity in Shanghai.

The Blackwell series has been subject to U.S. export controls, and it may not be exported to China without U.S. government approval. President Trump has also stated that he does not want such high‑end chips to flow into China.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang previously said that the equipment is too large to smuggle, noting that a standard GB300 NVL72 server rack weighs over 1,500 kg and is about 2 m tall.

Bloomberg entered the serial numbers listed in the documents into a public warranty database and confirmed that the GB300 rack was manufactured by Taiwanese Gigabyte (2376‑TW). Gigabyte assembles Nvidia chips into servers and racks.
Shanghai Shuoyao confirmed this month that it is a service provider for Megaspeed and described its relationship with the company as "limited to general commercial cooperation."

Megaspeed was founded by Huang Le in 2023 and was added to the U.S. trade blacklist by the Trump administration this month. The U.S. government said the company poses a significant risk of chip transshipment, while Megaspeed denies any wrongdoing.

Huang Le is linked to several companies investing in the Yangtze River Delta data centre project. An insider revealed that the centre’s chairman, Kang Wei, is sometimes introduced as Huang Le’s husband.

Shanghai Kezhan is 83.3% owned by Japan’s NeXPower, headquartered in Tokyo. Chinese financial media have reported that NeXPower is controlled by Huang Le. The remaining 16.7% is owned by a subsidiary of the Chinese gaming company Seventh Avenue (00797‑HK), which was originally the parent company of Megaspeed.
According to Big Trade Data, Shanghai Kezhan received a shipment worth 11 million U.S. dollars in May 2025, air‑freighted from Malaysia to Shanghai Pudong International Airport.

Customs documents described the shipment as "storage cases," but the declared HS code 847150 actually represents "computing servers," and each unit was priced at $264,108, within the price range of servers equipped with Nvidia Hopper series chips.

Regulatory filings also show that Shanghai Innovation Bank provided an additional loan of 200 million yuan to Shanghai Longjie. Shanghai Longjie is part of the same parent company as Shanghai Shuoyao and used equipment with export‑restricted Nvidia Hopper generation chips as collateral.
The hardware was manufactured by Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) and Dell Technologies (DELL-US). It is unclear whether the equipment obtained U.S. government approval when shipped to China.

items.title: 台積電A14製程就緒！1.4奈米晶片設計啟動 2028下半年量產
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)先進製程再進一步！A14（1.4奈米）製程設計套件（PDK）0.9版正式就緒，客戶可以啟動晶片設計。新製程採用第二代奈米片電晶體與NanoFlex Pro架構，相較N2P，同功耗下效能提升14%，同效能下功耗降低23%。台積電計劃2027年下半年進行風險試產，2028年下半年量產。
11月26日，台積電在2026年歐洲開放創新平台（OIP）生態系統研討會上宣布，下一代A14先進製程的PDK 0.9版本已經準備就緒，客戶可以正式啟動晶片設計工作。
台積電A14已經從技術研發進一步邁入客戶設計導入階段。從電晶體架構到EDA工具認證，台積電正在為1.4奈米級製程建立完整的產業化生態系。
A14是台積電繼N2、N2P之後布局的下一代1.4奈米級先進製程，也是其先進邏輯製造路線的重要節點。
PDK（Process Design Kit，製程設計套件）是晶片設計企業與晶圓代工廠之間的重要技術介面，包含電晶體模型、製程參數、設計規則及驗證資訊。晶片設計企業需要基於PDK完成電路設計、模擬、布局繞線及驗證，確保晶片符合晶圓廠的製造要求。
PDK 0.9就緒，意味著客戶已經可以啟動A14晶片設計導入，但並不代表製程已經完全定型，更不意味著晶片已經進入量產。
按照台積電規劃，A14預計2027年下半年進入風險試產，2028年下半年實現量產。接下來仍需經歷流片驗證、良率爬坡及客戶認證等環節。

性能提升14%、功耗降低23%！第二代奈米片電晶體登場

相比製程名稱的變化，A14更值得關注的是電晶體架構和標準單元設計的升級。
A14採用台積電第二代奈米片電晶體（Nanosheet），並引入NanoFlex Pro標準單元架構。
奈米片電晶體屬於全環繞閘極（GAA）技術路線。與傳統FinFET相比，GAA透過讓閘極從多個方向環繞通道，增強對電流的控制能力，有助於降低漏電並支援電晶體進一步微縮。
在A14上，台積電進一步優化奈米片結構，透過NanoFlex Pro實現不同效能和功耗需求的彈性配置。其中包括兩類重要設計：

Boost Cells高速單元：用於關鍵運算路徑，提升訊號傳輸速度和運算效能。
Low-Power Cells低功耗單元：用於一般邏輯區域，透過優化電晶體結構降低功耗。


這種設計讓晶片工程師可以根據不同模組的需求，彈性配置高速單元和低功耗單元，在效能與能源效率之間取得更好的平衡。根據台積電公布的數據，A14相較採用NanoFlex的N2P：

相同功耗下，效能提升14%。
相同效能下，總功耗降低23%。


此外，以基礎版N2P為比較基準，台積電還公布了能源效率提升50%、電晶體密度提升22%、邏輯密度提升23%的數據。

Cadence、新思科技完成認證！EDA生態系成為關鍵

先進製程能否真正實現商業化，不僅取決於晶圓製造技術，還取決於EDA工具、IP及設計生態系能否同步成熟。
此次台積電A14開放客戶設計，另一個重要進展就是EDA生態系取得突破。
目前，Cadence和Synopsys（新思科技）已經完成基於Arm Cortex-A725處理器核心的完整設計流程認證，涵蓋綜合、實體實現以及電氣和實體簽核等環節。
Synopsys在台積電公布的A14 v0.9工具認證統計中涵蓋13項認證類別，Cadence涵蓋12項。Siemens EDA也在推進相關工具認證，但部分項目仍在進行中。
為什麼EDA生態系如此重要？隨著先進製程不斷微縮，晶片設計複雜度持續提升。設計人員必須同時解決時序、功耗、訊號完整性、電遷移及熱管理等問題。
如果缺少成熟的EDA工具和經過驗證的IP，即使晶圓廠擁有先進製造技術，晶片設計企業也很難充分發揮其效能優勢。
因此，A14開放設計不僅是台積電的製程進展，也是全球EDA產業鏈進入下一輪技術競爭的重要訊號。

A13路線同步公布！2028年後繼續推進製程升級

在公布A14設計生態系進展的同時，台積電還進一步揭露後續A13技術路線。
A13並非完全獨立的新架構，而是基於A14進一步優化的衍生節點，重點在於提高電晶體布局效率和晶片面積利用率。
根據台積電公布的資訊，A13可以在不改變現有A14設計流程的情況下，將晶片裸晶面積縮小約6%。透過進一步調整M0金屬層、OD結構及VT Flex單元配置，還可以額外獲得約5%的能源效率提升。
這意味著，台積電將透過A14、A13連續迭代，持續改善效能、功耗和晶片面積效率，為AI晶片、CPU及高階行動SoC提供更先進的製造平台。

台積電、英特爾、三星，1.4奈米級競爭全面升級

A14開放客戶設計，也讓全球先進製程競爭進入新的階段。
目前，台積電、英特爾(INTC-US)和三星都在積極布局下一代先進製造技術。
台積電： A14已經開放客戶設計，目標2028年下半年量產，憑藉先進製程、客戶生態系及先進封裝能力保持競爭優勢。
英特爾： 14A採用第二代RibbonFET電晶體和PowerDirect背面供電技術，並透過Turbo Cells優化關鍵路徑效能，正在推進PDK及客戶導入。
三星： 繼續推進SF1.4製程路線，試圖透過GAA架構、先進製造以及記憶體和邏輯業務協同，爭取高階晶片客戶。
需要指出的是，三家企業的節點名稱不能簡單按照1.4奈米、14A等數字直接比較。不同廠商的命名規則、電晶體結構、設計密度和製程指標並不完全相同。
真正決定競爭結果的仍是電晶體效能、功耗、邏輯密度、製造良率、生產成本及客戶導入情況。

items.title: 前高盛策略師警告：風險資產將全面崩跌 逼得Fed 12月放棄升息
items.title_en: Former Goldman Sachs Strategist Warns: Risk Assets Could Crash, Pressuring Fed to Abandon December Rate Hike
paras: 市場普遍押注聯準會12月升息1碼，前高盛首席外匯策略師布魯克斯（Robin Brooks）卻警告，股市與商品市場可能等不到決策揭曉就先崩跌。
魯克斯認為，聯準會在油價下跌之際仍堅持緊縮，已推升實質利率。若官員未及時釋出政策放軟的訊號，風險資產恐遭遇失序賣壓，反過來迫使聯準會放棄升息。
油價下跌、美元走強 套利交易平倉添壓
現任布魯金斯學會資深研究員的布魯克斯本週接連發文，直指聯準會在油價走弱時升息是一項政策錯誤。
依他的觀察，實質利率異常攀升，正壓低各類資產估值。一度受到投資人青睞的套利交易也出現混亂平倉，推動美元兌新興市場貨幣大幅走強。
油市與匯市已見明顯變化。西德州中質原油（WTI）週一跌至每桶79.25美元，創8月10日以來新低。衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣走勢的美元指數，自9月中旬以來一直守在100之上，近期更攀至104.5，創9個月新高。
賣壓也波及美股與黃金。標普500指數(INX) 上週五收在6,882點，創4月中旬以來最低收盤紀錄。
布魯克斯指出，就連黃仁勳回歸輝達(NVDA-US) ，也未能重燃投資人熱情。金價則寫下逾40年來最大的60日跌幅。
聯準會將進入緘默期 官員安撫市場時間有限
聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）將於12月8日至9日開會，11月28日起進入會前緘默期。
屆時，官員將無法公開評論貨幣政策與經濟情勢。這也是布魯克斯特別在意的時間點，一旦賣壓在會前加劇，官員能透過公開談話穩住市場的空間相當有限。
聯準會理事沃勒上週甚至表示，為了壓制通膨，聯準會可能需要升息2碼，給市場一次震撼。隨著能源價格下跌，這番鷹派談話加深了投資人對經濟能否承受緊縮步調的疑慮。
布魯克斯認為，聯準會主動放軟立場的可能性愈來愈低，若市場先失控，12月9日的決策反而可能是按兵不動。
市場仍押升息1碼 按兵不動機率僅1.4%
衍生性商品市場對12月會議的預期，與布魯克斯的警告仍有明顯落差。根據芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具，交易員普遍預期聯準會將升息1碼，維持目標利率區間在3.75%至4%的機率僅1.4%。
若未來幾天金融環境進一步收緊，聯準會將面臨兩難。照市場預期升息，可能碰上市場正在拋售風險資產；選擇按兵不動，又可能被解讀為向賣壓低頭。
接下來幾個交易日，交易員將緊盯美元是否續強、油價是否持續低於每桶80美元，以及緘默期前市場對升息的押注是否鬆動。
paras_en: The market broadly bets that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter point in December, but former Goldman Sachs chief FX strategist Robin Brooks warned that equity and commodity markets may tumble before the decision is even announced.

Brooks believes that the Fed’s continued tightening amid falling oil prices has pushed real rates higher. If officials do not promptly signal a policy easing, risk assets could face disorderly selling, which in turn could force the Fed to abandon the hike.
Falling oil prices and a strengthening dollar add pressure as arbitrage trades unwind.
Brooks, now a senior researcher at the Brookings Institution, posted a series of comments this week, directly calling a rate hike during weak oil prices a policy mistake.

He observes that real rates are climbing unusually, suppressing valuations across asset classes. Arbitrage trades that were once popular among investors are now being liquidated in a chaotic fashion, driving the dollar sharply higher against emerging‑market currencies.

The oil and currency markets have already shown clear shifts. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude fell to $79.25 per barrel on Monday, a low not seen since August 10. The U.S. Dollar Index, which measures the greenback against a basket of major currencies, has stayed above 100 since mid‑September and recently rose to 104.5, a nine‑month high.
Selling pressure has also spilled over to U.S. equities and gold. The S&P 500 (INX) closed last Friday at 6,882 points, the lowest close since mid‑April.
Brooks noted that even Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia (NVDA-US) failed to rekindle investor enthusiasm, and gold posted its biggest 60‑day decline in more than four decades.
The Fed will enter a quiet period, limiting officials’ ability to soothe markets.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will meet on December 8‑9, and a pre‑meeting quiet period begins on November 28.

During that time, officials cannot publicly comment on monetary policy or economic conditions. This is a key moment for Brooks, because if selling intensifies before the meeting, officials will have very little room to calm markets through public remarks.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said last week that, to curb inflation, the Fed may need to raise rates by two quarter‑point moves, delivering a shock to markets. With energy prices falling, his hawkish tone deepened investors’ doubts about whether the economy can withstand further tightening.
Brooks argues that the likelihood of the Fed proactively easing is diminishing; if markets get out of hand, the December 9 decision could end up being a hold.
Markets still bet on a one‑quarter‑point hike, with the probability of a hold at only 1.4%.

Derivatives market expectations for the December meeting still diverge sharply from Brooks’s warning. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders largely expect a one‑quarter‑point hike, giving a 1.4% chance that the Fed will keep the target range at 3.75%‑4%.

If financial conditions tighten further in the coming days, the Fed will face a dilemma. Raising rates as the market sells risk assets could backfire; holding steady could be read as capitulating to selling pressure.

In the next few trading days, traders will watch closely whether the dollar stays strong, oil remains below $80 per barrel, and whether the market’s bet on a rate hike eases before the quiet period ends.

items.title: 荷蘭抵制美國新規！反對擴大半導體曝光設備對中出口管制
items.title_en: Netherlands Resists New U.S. Rules! Opposes Expanding Export Controls on Semiconductor Lithography Equipment to China
paras: 據《彭博社》報導，荷蘭政府明確表示，將抵制美國進一步限制曝光設備對中國出口的「MATCH」法案，並稱擬議規則將對歐洲曝光設備公司構成威脅。
美國的「硬體技術多邊協調管制法案」（Match Act）旨在收緊半導體組件對中出口，將迫使荷蘭及其他盟友加強對先進設備的出口管制。荷蘭貿易大臣Sjoerd Sjoerdsma表示，荷蘭政府反對該法案的域外適用範圍。
在荷蘭數月來力圖阻止「Match Act」通過之後，Sjoerdsma的言論標誌著措辭的升級。荷蘭政府正在遊說，以確保該法案不被附到即將出台的美國國防法案上，因為該法案單獨闖關通過的可能性較小。AI資料中心和先進智慧型手機所用尖端半導體的生產，離不開曝光設備。
雖然最先進的EUV曝光設備早已被禁止對華出口，但預計「Match Act」將擴大這些限制，波及浸潤式DUV曝光設備對中國銷售與服務。中國是荷蘭曝光設備製造商最大的市場之一，預計今年將佔其收入的20%。
「我們將探討我們有哪些選擇，包括雙邊和歐洲層面的選項，如有必要，還會動用其他手段，」Sjoerdsma說道，但他沒有具體說明可能的應對措施。「但即便如此，如果這項法律獲得通過，我們也會盡力阻止其實施。」
據知情人士透露，荷蘭在與歐盟大使的會談中，呼籲歐盟採取協調一致的應對措施。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, the Dutch government has made clear it will resist the U.S. “MATCH” bill that seeks to further restrict the export of lithography equipment to China, saying the proposed rules would threaten European lithography equipment companies.

The U.S. “Hardware Technology Multilateral Coordination Control Act” (Match Act) aims to tighten exports of semiconductor components to China, forcing the Netherlands and other allies to tighten export controls on advanced equipment. Dutch trade minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma said the Netherlands opposes the extraterritorial reach of the bill.

After months of trying to block the Match Act in the Netherlands, Sjoerdsma’s remarks mark an escalation in tone. The Dutch government is lobbying to ensure the bill is not attached to an upcoming U.S. defense bill, as the chances of it passing on its own are low. Production of cutting‑edge semiconductors for AI data centers and advanced smartphones depends on lithography equipment.

Although the most advanced EUV lithography tools have already been banned from export to China, the Match Act is expected to broaden those restrictions to include the sale and service of immersion DUV lithography equipment to China. China is one of the biggest markets for Dutch lithography equipment makers, projected to account for about 20% of their revenue this year.

“We will explore what options we have, including bilateral and European‑level measures, and if necessary we will resort to other tools,” Sjoerdsma said, without specifying what actions might be taken. “But even so, if this law is passed we will do everything we can to block its implementation.”
According to informed sources, the Netherlands, in talks with EU ambassadors, has called on the European Union to adopt a coordinated response.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉AI強勢回血！標普創2025年4月來最佳單周 Sandisk飆16% Anthropic重返IPO價
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: AI Leads Strong Recovery, S&P Posts Best Weekly Gain Since April 2025, Sandisk Jumps 16%, Anthropic Returns to IPO Price
paras: 人工智慧(AI)股吹起反彈號角，幫助美股主要指數周五(27日)全面收高，結束這個劇烈波動且因假期縮短的一周。道瓊一周來上漲近600點，創2022年來最大單周漲點，標普500指數也締造2025年4月以來最佳單周表現。
美股周四因感恩節休市一天，周五雖然恢復交易，但提早收盤。
本月遭投資人重挫的晶片股收復近期部分失土，美光(MU-US)與邁威爾)(Marvell)(MRVL-US)周五分別上漲7.6%及7.3%。 AI受惠股也大幅走高，資料儲存業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)股價飆漲近16%，光學產品製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)及伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)分別勁揚8%和6.7%。
營運大型資料中心的大型AI雲端業者(Hyperscalers)，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta Platforms(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)，股價全面上漲。
川普周四坦承，近期市場動盪一度讓他感到擔憂。這波震盪格外劇烈，是數月來籠罩華爾街的市場波動進一步升高的表現，反映AI熱潮背後的金融與經濟利害關係日益重大。
本周稍早公布的數據顯示，美國經濟第3季成長速度遠高於初估，10月通膨也進一步加速。交易員幾乎完全押注聯準會(Fed)將在12月升息。
本周道瓊工業指數上漲5.46%，標普500指數上漲5.6%，那斯達克指數上漲6.68%，使三大指數創下2008年以來最佳感恩節周的表現。當時正逢金融危機期間，三大指數當年周漲幅各為9.7%、12%、10.9%。
不過本周的反彈仍不足以收復11月以來的跌幅，標普500指數與那斯達克指數恐交出2008年以來最差11月表現。市場擔憂民主黨贏得美國期中選舉後，AI監管可能趨嚴，加上貨幣政策預料將持續緊縮，都對股市構成壓力。
美股周五(27日)主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲591.99點，或1.18%，收50,774.94點。
那斯達克綜合指數上漲543.70點，或2.31%，收24,129.50點。
標普500指數上漲114.71點，或1.60%，收7,297.49點。
費城半導體指數上漲411.84點，或4.69%，收9,186.71點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲452.98點，或2.82%，收16,510.93點。


標普11大類股中全數上漲，基本金屬、科技類股漲最多。

焦點個股

NYSE FANG + 指數中的科技五大巨頭多上揚。Meta(META-US)上漲3.13%；蘋果(AAPL-US)上漲0.83%；Alphabet(GOOGL-US)下跌0.68%；微軟(MSFT-US)上漲0.60%；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)上漲3.96%。
費半成分股幾乎全面上漲。Coherent(COHR-US)飆逾14%，美光(MU-US)大漲7.6%，邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)漲7.3%，英特爾(INTC-US)漲4.75%，超微(AMD-US)漲3.87%。
台股ADR跌漲互見。台積電ADR(TSM-US)上漲3.21%；日月光 ADR(ASX-US)上漲6.27%；聯電ADR(UMC-US)上漲1.90%；中華電信ADR(CHT-US)上漲0.54%。

企業新聞

Anthropic(ANT-US)周五大漲10.98%，收在每股91.88美元，重新站上每股83美元的首次公開發行(IPO)價，反映AI交易全面回溫，吸引從假期重返市場的投資人，分析師的正面評等也為股價提供支撐。
由阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)領導的Anthropic目前市值約1.7兆美元，仍低於11月19日掛牌首日股價觸及115.10美元時、市值一度超過2兆美元的高點。 投資人接下來將觀察，Anthropic能否在12月15日閉鎖期屆滿前，持續守住IPO發行價
SpaceX(SPCX-US)勁揚4.83%，報每股133.59美元。全球首富馬斯克在感恩節當天於社群平台X發文表示，除了贈送美國每個兒童2股SpaceX股票之外，每年還會加碼贈送1股，以目前股價計算，每年額外贈股的總價值將近90億美元。
輝達周五盤中走勢震盪，終場勉力上漲0.8%，報每股150.49美元。黃仁勳戲劇性回鍋擔任執行長之後，預定下周四赴美國參議院銀行委員會作證，將成為市場焦點。標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)周三則將輝達信用評等列入「負向觀察」名單，代表評等遭調降的可能性很高。
行動通訊巨頭威瑞森(Verizon Communications)(VZ-US)上漲0.55%，報每股47.54美元。《金融時報》(FT)報導，該公司正洽談以60億美元收購寬頻業者Fidium，藉此擴大網路版圖，在全美吸引更多網路服務用戶。
Vertex Pharmaceuticals(VRTZ-US)重挫5.2%，報每股534.57美元。美國監管機關宣布，該公司治療慢性腎臟疾病藥物的核准決定將延後最多三個月，為此藥上市之路新增障礙。

華爾街分析

經過數周市場不安，投資人持續質疑AI支出能否帶來相應回報，企業借貸成本上升、監管趨嚴，以及這項技術帶來的風險等問題，仍未獲得解答。市場接下來將密切觀察，AI股這波賣壓是否已經告一段落。
摩根士丹利投資管理公司資深投資組合經理Andrew Slimmon說：「科技股反彈從周一開始，周三盤中反轉後延續，今天又持續走高。大量短線資金已經解除科技股部位，這波反彈下周可能持續，因為這些資金被迫回頭追買。」
Annex財富管理公司分析師Brian Jacobsen表示，當市場發現原先擔憂的風險並未實現，先前的避險賣壓最終就會逆轉。他並指出，長期投資人會把市場修正視為重新檢視持股的時機，而不是退出市場的理由。
Jacobsen表示：「購物者在這個假期購物季會尋找便宜貨，沒有理由認為投資人不能做同樣的事。」
目前由於風險偏好回升，投資人減少對美國公債等避險資產的需求。
The Sevens Report的Tom Essaye指出，本周市場表現最重要的訊息是，AI投資題材仍有許多問題亟待解決。他表示：「在市場能夠清楚掌握接下來的發展之前，我們應該預期波動將持續。」
下周市場焦點將轉向美國11月非農就業報告，這是Fed 12月8日至9日政策會議前最受矚目的經濟數據，若數據顯示美國經濟愈來愈熱絡，可能促使央行採取更強硬的立場，對已經遭受重創的股票構成壓力。
根據LSEG調查的經濟學家預估，美國11月非農就業人口將增加9萬人，失業率為4.1%。10月非農就業人口則大增16.5萬人，遠高於經濟學家的預期。
Wealth Enhancement資深投資策略師Ayako Yoshioka說：「強勁的經濟成長背景，只會給Fed另一個更有信心升息的理由。因此，這是一把雙面刃。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: AI stocks sounded the rebound bugle, helping all major U.S. indices close higher on Friday (the 27th) and ending a volatile week that was shortened by the holiday. The Dow rose nearly 600 points, its biggest weekly gain since 2022, while the S&P 500 posted its best weekly performance since April 2025.
U.S. markets were closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving, and although trading resumed on Friday, the session ended early.

Chip stocks that had been hammered this month reclaimed some of their recent losses, with Micron (MU‑US) and Marvell (MRVL‑US) up 7.6% and 7.3% respectively on Friday. AI‑benefiting names also surged: data‑storage firm Sandisk (SNDK‑US) jumped almost 16%, while optical‑product maker Lumentum (LITE‑US) and server maker Dell (DELL‑US) rose 8% and 6.7% respectively.
Large‑scale AI cloud providers (hyperscalers) – Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) – all saw their shares rise.

Trump admitted on Thursday that recent market turbulence had worried him. The swing was especially sharp, reflecting a further escalation of the volatility that has loomed over Wall Street for months and underscoring the growing financial and economic stakes behind the AI boom.
Data released earlier this week showed U.S. Q3 growth far outpacing estimates and October inflation accelerating. Traders are almost unanimously betting that the Fed will raise rates in December.

The Dow Industrial Average climbed 5.46%, the S&P 500 rose 5.6%, and the Nasdaq gained 6.68%, giving the three major indices their best Thanksgiving‑week performance since 2008. Back then, during the financial crisis, the weekly gains were 9.7%, 12% and 10.9% respectively.

However, the rebound this week was still insufficient to erase the declines since November, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq could end up delivering their worst November performance since 2008. Markets worry that a Democratic win in the U.S. midterms could tighten AI regulation, and that monetary policy is likely to stay restrictive, both weighing on equities.
U.S. market performance on Friday (the 27th):

The Dow Industrial Average rose 591.99 points, or 1.18%, to close at 50,774.94.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 543.70 points, or 2.31%, to finish at 24,129.50.
The S&P 500 added 114.71 points, or 1.60%, to end at 7,297.49.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 411.84 points, or 4.69%, to settle at 9,186.71.
The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 452.98 points, or 2.82%, to close at 16,510.93.

All 11 S&P sector groups were up, with basic materials and technology leading the gains.

Key stocks

Most of the five big‑cap tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index were higher. Meta (META‑US) rose 3.13%; Apple (AAPL‑US) up 0.83%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slipped 0.68%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) gained 0.60%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) climbed 3.96%.

Almost all components of the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index were higher. Coherent (COHR‑US) surged more than 14%; Micron (MU‑US) jumped 7.6%; Marvell (MRVL‑US) rose 7.3%; Intel (INTC‑US) up 4.75%; AMD (AMD‑US) up 3.87%.
Taiwan ADRs showed mixed moves. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 3.21%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 6.27%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.90%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 0.54%.

Company news

Anthropic (ANT‑US) surged 10.98% on Friday to close at $91.88, retaking its IPO price of $83 and reflecting a broad AI‑trade rebound that attracted investors returning from the holiday. Positive analyst ratings also supported the price.

Led by Dario Amodei, Anthropic now has a market value of about $1.7 trillion, still below the peak of over $2 trillion it briefly hit when the stock first traded on November 19 at $115.10. Investors will watch whether Anthropic can hold its IPO price through the December 15 lock‑up expiration.

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) jumped 4.83% to $133.59 per share. Billionaire Elon Musk posted on X on Thanksgiving that, in addition to giving every U.S. child two shares of SpaceX stock, he will add one more share each year. At current prices, the annual extra‑share giveaway is worth nearly $9 billion.

NVIDIA was volatile during the session on Friday but managed a modest 0.8% gain to close at $150.49. After Jensen Huang dramatically returned as CEO, he is slated to testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee next Thursday, making him a market focal point. S&P Global Ratings placed NVIDIA on a “negative watch” list on Wednesday, indicating a high likelihood of a rating downgrade.

Verizon Communications (VZ‑US) rose 0.55% to $47.54. The Financial Times reported the company is negotiating a $6 billion acquisition of broadband provider Fidium to expand its network footprint and attract more U.S. broadband customers.

Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTZ‑US) fell 5.2% to $534.57. U.S. regulators announced that approval of the company’s chronic kidney disease drug will be delayed by up to three months, adding another hurdle to the product’s launch.

Wall Street analysis

After weeks of market unease, investors continue to question whether AI spending will generate commensurate returns. Rising corporate borrowing costs, tighter regulation, and the inherent risks of the technology remain unresolved. The market will watch closely to see if the selling pressure on AI stocks has finally abated.

Andrew Slimmon, a senior portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, said: “The tech rebound started on Monday, continued after a mid‑week reversal, and kept climbing today. A lot of short‑term capital has already exited tech positions, so this bounce could persist into next week as that capital is forced to chase stocks back.”

Brian Jacobsen, an analyst at Annex Wealth Management, said that when the market sees the feared risks not materializing, the earlier hedging sell‑off will reverse. He added that long‑term investors tend to view corrections as an opportunity to reassess holdings rather than a reason to exit.
Jacobsen noted: “Shoppers look for bargains during the holiday season, and there’s no reason investors can’t do the same.”
Currently, with risk appetite returning, investors are reducing demand for safe‑haven assets such as U.S. Treasuries.

Tom Essaye of The Sevens Report said the most important takeaway from this week’s market action is that many questions surrounding AI investment remain unresolved. He warned: “Until the market can clearly see what comes next, we should expect volatility to continue.”

Next week’s focus will shift to the U.S. November non‑farm payroll report, the most closely watched data point ahead of the Fed’s Dec 8‑9 policy meeting. A stronger‑than‑expected reading could push the central bank toward a more hawkish stance, adding pressure to stocks that have already taken a hit.
Economists surveyed by LSEG expect November non‑farm payrolls to increase by 90,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate at 4.1%. October’s payrolls rose by 165,000, well above expectations.

Ayako Yoshioka, senior investment strategist at Wealth Enhancement, said: “Robust economic‑growth fundamentals only give the Fed another reason to feel confident about raising rates. So it’s a double‑edged sword.”

items.title_en: Japan to Impose Anti‑Dumping Duties on BPA from Taiwan and South Korea Starting Dec 3: 8.7% for Nan‑Ya, 2.4% for Chang‑Chun
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本財務省公布，內閣已通過對台灣及南韓產雙酚A課徵反傾銷稅，預計12月3日生效，為期五年。台灣方面，南亞塑膠(1303-TW)及其他台灣供應商適用8.7%，長春人造樹脂適用2.4%，兩者相差6.3個百分點。南韓錦湖P&B化學及其他業者適用7%，LG化學產品則不在課稅範圍。
雙酚A是製造聚碳酸酯及環氧樹脂的原料。日本財務省調查顯示，2024年度日本雙酚A需求較2021年度減少28%，調查認定涉及傾銷的台韓產品進口量卻增加118%，同期日本國產雙酚A銷量減少40%。

paras_en: On November 28, 2026 (reported by Yō Analysis/Industry Data Center), Japan’s Ministry of Finance announced that the cabinet has approved anti‑dumping duties on bisphenol A (BPA) imports from Taiwan and South Korea, to take effect on December 3 for a period of five years. For Taiwan, Nan‑Ya Plastics (1303‑TW) and other Taiwanese suppliers will be subject to an 8.7% duty, while Chang‑Chun Synthetic Resin will face a 2.4% duty, a difference of 6.3 percentage points. Bisphenol A is a raw material used to produce polycarbonate and epoxy resins. A survey by Japan’s Ministry of Finance shows that domestic demand for BPA fell by 28% in fiscal 2024 compared with fiscal 2021, while imports of Taiwanese and South Korean products identified as being dumped rose by 118% over the same period, and domestic BPA sales dropped by 40%.

items.title: 景旺電子砸26.8億元擴產鎖定800G至3.2T光模組PCB
items.title_en: Kinwong Electronics Invests 2.68 Billion RMB to Expand Production Targeting 800G to 3.2T Optical Module PCBs
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國PCB廠景旺電子Kinwong(603228-CN、3228-HK)董事會27日通過擴產案，計畫投入人民幣26.8億元，在廣東珠海斗門興建高階mSAP精密電路板產線，鎖定800G、1.6T及3.2T光模組。計畫由旗下珠海景泓執行，建設期估24個月，設備進場、安裝調校及試產將分階段進行。
這次是在既有製程上擴產。目前，珠海金灣基地上半年已建成3條mSAP產線，8月增至4條；最新公告確認5條產線均已建成，製程與材料供應已通過大批量生產驗證。公司表示，現有產線稼動率偏高，預估難以滿足客戶增加的交貨需求，因此在同市的斗門另建產線。新案尚未公布新增產能與首批出貨時間。
mSAP是改良型半加成製程，可在電路板上製作更細的線路，讓高速光模組在有限空間內配置更多連接。景旺半年報列出，800G、1.6T及以上的光模組板，線寬與線距可要求在25微米以下。此次把3.2T納入目標市場，但未公布各速率產品的產能配置。
台廠方面，華通(2313-TW)已量產出貨800G與1.6T光模組用mSAP板。公司27日在法說會表示，今年受缺料影響，光通訊業務出貨進度較內部預期慢約一至兩個月，但對2027年光模組需求與展望的看法不變，並持續在台灣廠及重慶二廠投入光模組板產能。

paras_en: On November 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The board of China PCB manufacturer Kinwong Electronics (603228-CN, 3228-HK) approved an expansion plan on the 27th, proposing to invest 2.68 billion RMB to build a high‑end mSAP precision circuit board production line in Doumen, Zhuhai, Guangdong, targeting 800G, 1.6T and 3.2T optical modules. The project will be carried out by its Zhuhai subsidiary Zhuhai Jinghong, with an estimated construction period of 24 months; equipment delivery, installation, calibration and trial production will be phased.

This expansion is on top of existing processes. Currently, three mSAP lines have been built at the Jinwan base in Zhuhai in the first half of the year, increasing to four in August; the latest announcement confirms that all five lines are now completed, and the processes and material supply have passed mass‑production validation. The company says the current lines are running at high utilization and are unlikely to meet the increased delivery demand, so a new line will be built in Doumen, the same city. The new project has not disclosed the added capacity or the first‑shipment timeline.

mSAP is an improved semi‑additive process that can create finer traces on circuit boards, allowing high‑speed optical modules to pack more connections in limited space. Kinwong’s half‑year report lists that for 800G, 1.6T and higher optical module boards, line width and spacing can be specified below 25 micrometres. This time the 3.2T speed is also included in the target market, though capacity allocation for each speed tier was not disclosed.

On the Taiwan side, Hua‑Tong (2313‑TW) has already mass‑produced and shipped mSAP boards for 800G and 1.6T optical modules. At its earnings briefing on the 27th, the company said that material shortages this year have slowed optical‑communication shipments by about one to two months compared with internal expectations, but its outlook for 2027 optical‑module demand remains unchanged, and it continues to invest in optical‑module board capacity at its Taiwan plant and a second plant in Chongqing.

items.title_en: OpenAI Countersues Apple Over Pressured Joint Suppliers and Acquisition of Unpublished Hardware Data
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ OpenAI與旗下硬體公司io Products於27日向美國加州北區聯邦法院提出反訴，指控蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)不當取得尚未公開的硬體設計與製造資料，並對雙方共用的供應商施壓。這是蘋果7月提告後，同一案件首次由OpenAI正式提出反訴。
OpenAI在反訴文件中指出，部分專業製程只有一至兩家供應商符合資格。OpenAI主張，一家表面處理業者因蘋果反對雙方產品在同一區域或同一時段加工，改將OpenAI的工件移到夜班，增加作業成本；另有一家製造商據稱退出原定合作，迫使OpenAI重新安排生產。公開文件未點名這兩家廠商。
OpenAI另指，一名後來重返蘋果的前員工，在離職前將未公開裝置的設計圖及製造檢測資料傳至個人帳號。蘋果7月起訴時則指控，兩名前蘋果員工將機密資料帶往OpenAI，供其開發消費性硬體。OpenAI否認蘋果的指控；雙方主張仍待法院審理。

paras_en: On November 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) — OpenAI and its hardware subsidiary io Products filed a countersuit in the U.S. Northern District of California on the 27th, accusing Apple (AAPL-US) of improperly obtaining unpublished hardware design and manufacturing information and pressuring suppliers shared by both parties. OpenAI alleges that a surface‑treatment vendor, opposed by Apple to processing both companies’ products in the same area or time slot, shifted OpenAI’s work to night shifts, raising operational costs; another manufacturer allegedly withdrew from a planned partnership, forcing OpenAI to rearrange production. OpenAI also claims that a former Apple employee who later returned to Apple transferred unpublished device schematics and manufacturing test data to a personal account before leaving. Apple’s July lawsuit alleged that two former Apple staff members took confidential data to OpenAI for developing consumer hardware. OpenAI denies Apple’s allegations; the claims await court adjudication.

paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 德國聯邦議院27日通過2027年聯邦預算，核心預算支出為5,559.4億歐元，較2026年預算增加約6%，但只比政府原案多5.1億歐元。相較之下，核心預算淨舉債提高至1,229.7億歐元，比原案多42.4億歐元，也高於2026年預算的980億歐元。

paras_en: On November 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The German Bundestag on the 27th passed the 2027 federal budget, with core budget expenditures of €555.94 billion, about a 6% increase over the 2026 budget but only €0.51 billion more than the government’s original proposal. By contrast, net borrowing in the core budget rose to €122.97 billion, €4.24 billion higher than the original draft and also above the €98 billion net borrowing in the 2026 budget.

The adjustment is most evident in the spending structure. Investment spending within the core budget increased to €61.85 billion, €5.58 billion more than the government’s original plan and roughly a 6% rise over the 2026 budget. The original proposal’s core investment was lower than in 2026, whereas the version approved by parliament shifts to an increase.

Beyond the core budget, separate borrowing limits exist for the Infrastructure and Climate Neutrality Special Fund and the Federal Defense Forces Special Fund. Including these two funds, new borrowing for 2027 totals about €210.4 billion. Finance Minister Christian Lindner said public investment is the main driver of growth, and the government hopes to stimulate more private investment in 2027.

items.title: Google比利時資料中心遭勒令停工每小時600立方公尺取水計畫卡關
items.title_en: Google Belgium Data Center Ordered to Halt Construction, 600 Cubic Meters per Hour Water Intake Plan Stalled
paras: 2026年11月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 比利時瓦隆地區26日勒令Google暫停一座資料中心施工。當地官員表示，稽查人員到場時，約3公頃的建物主體已接近完工，但工程採用的變更方案未取得許可。
Google原獲准興建三座採氣冷的資料中心，後來申請把其中兩座合併，並改從附近的桑布爾河取水冷卻。依瓦隆議會文件，變更方案擬每小時取水600立方公尺，排回河道的水量不到四分之一。瓦隆官員今年8月駁回申請，理由是難以保證在20年許可期間內，即使遇上高溫與乾旱仍有足夠水量。
原有的三座氣冷資料中心許可仍然有效，其中一座截至10月已建成。Google旗下Crystal Computing已向比利時國務院聲請暫停執行並撤銷駁回決定，暫停執行案預定2027年1月7日開庭。

paras_en: On November 26, officials in Belgium's Walloon region ordered Google to suspend construction of a data center. The local authorities said that when inspectors arrived, the main building covering about 3 hectares was nearly completed, but the revised plan for the project had not been approved.

Google was originally granted permission to build three air‑cooled data centers, but later applied to merge two of them and switch to drawing cooling water from the nearby Sambre River. According to Walloon Parliament documents, the revised plan called for taking 600 cubic meters of water per hour, with less than a quarter of that volume being returned to the river. Walloon officials rejected the application in August, citing the inability to guarantee sufficient water supply over the 20‑year permit period, even during heatwaves and droughts.

The permits for the original three air‑cooled data centers remain valid, and one of them was completed by October. Google’s subsidiary Crystal Computing has petitioned the Belgian Council of Ministers to suspend enforcement and overturn the rejection, with a hearing on the suspension scheduled for January 7, 2027.
